title: Executive Assistant and Management Support
employer: THE ASSOCIATION FOR THE EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES TRANSPARENCY INITIATIVE (EITI)
description:
Who are we?

Founded on the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) brings together governments, civil society and companies to improve natural resource governance. With over 50 member countries and 60 supporting companies, the EITI promotes transparency, accountability and informed policymaking in the extractive sector. 

Behind this ambitious and impactful organisation is a diverse and dynamic team of experts working together to advance the EITI mission. Based in Oslo, Norway, the EITI International Secretariat comprises a collaborative, multinational and multilingual team of around 60 professionals who value growth and development, strong relationships, open dialogue and inclusive leadership.

What are we looking for

We are seeking an Oslo-based, experienced and highly organised person to support the Executive Director and Board Chair. The successful candidate will have strong interpersonal and organisational skills and exercise discretion and confidentiality when handling correspondence and other sensitive information.The role requires excellent time management and the ability to prioritise competing demands, manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail. A proactive approach to problem-solving, a willingness to take on a variety of responsibilities and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment are essential. The role will report to the Executive Director. 

Duties and responsibilities
  • Coordinate travel authorisations and confirm budget availability in line with relevant policies.
  • Plan missions with country teams, including travel bookings, visa applications, itineraries and transport.
  • Arrange meetings and compile materials needed for travel and missions.
  • Prepare travel claims and track expenses in accordance with relevant policies.
  • Monitor the Executive Director’s and Board Chair’s inboxes and urgent messages, draft approved correspondence and follow up with staff and EITI stakeholders.
  • Ensure the Executive Director’s leave and working hours are accurately recorded.
  • Maintain and archive the Senior Management Team’s agenda items, and coordinate meeting agendas in line with internal policies.
  • Support engagement with the supporting countries constituency by scheduling meetings and liaising with the Finance Manager on reporting and budget queries.
  • Schedule Senior Management Team meetings, invite relevant colleagues and record and communicate decisions and action points.
  • Coordinate Senior Management Team activities, including assistance in organising retreats and the coordination of leave schedules.
  • Provide targeted administrative support across the Secretariat, including assisting the Operations team when needed and helping to coordinate internal events, recognising the close links between the team’s work and support for the Executive Director and Board Chair.
Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business Administration or similar.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as an executive assistant or office administrative assistant.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and digital finance/travel systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new digital systems quickly.
  • Working knowledge of data management and data protection (GDPR) principles.

Desirable:

  • Experience working in an international environment and with international organisations.
  • Working knowledge of French and Spanish.
We can offer

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a multi-stakeholder organisation driving positive global change. 

Located in central Oslo, the EITI International Secretariat offers hybrid work options, attractive benefits and an above-market pension and insurance package. See information about the benefits we offer here.The Secretariat can offer employment in Norway based on the Norwegian salary structure. Indicative gross salary benchmarking suggests a range of NOK 560,000 to NOK 580,000. The final offer will be determined based on factors including the labour market, role requirements, internal equity, budget and the successful candidate’s experience and skills.

This is an Oslo-based role. The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in Norway and hold any required work permit before starting the position. Relocation support is not provided.Email applications will not be considered. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

ContactsJeanette Reinertsen LocationRådhusgata 26 0151 Oslo Key information:Employer: Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) Reference number: 5216177116 Percentage of full-time: 100% Permanent position Application deadline: 11/12/2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) is the global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources.

Guided by the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the EITI has established a global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources. The EITI Standard requires the disclosure of information along the extractive industry value chain from the point of extraction, to how revenues make their way through the government, and how they benefit the public. By doing so, the EITI seeks to strengthen public and corporate governance, promote understanding of natural resource management, and provide the data to inform reforms for greater transparency and accountability in the extractives sector. In each of the 55 implementing countries, the EITI is supported by a coalition of government, companies, and civil society.

The EITI is committed to achieving diversity in terms of gender, nationality, culture and educational background. The EITI is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Commissioning Manager
description:
The Opportunity

Fossefall is building the infrastructure needed to power Europe's AI future. As our GPU and AI data centre projects move from design and procurement into construction, testing and operational readiness, we need a Commissioning Manager who can turn our commissioning strategy into a coordinated, evidence-based delivery plan.

Reporting to the VP Commissioning, you will lead owner-side project commissioning from design review and factory testing through installation verification, start-up, integrated systems testing and handover. You will connect engineering, construction, suppliers, Operations and IT delivery, identify gaps early and provide clear recommendations on readiness and acceptance. The role is based in Oslo with a hybrid working model and regular travel to project sites and supplier facilities.

What you'll do

  • Develop and maintain the project Commissioning Plan, scope, schedule, resource plan and readiness gates, integrated with construction, utility availability and phased delivery.

  • Review designs and supplier documentation for testability, maintainability and operational requirements.

  • Coordinate the full L1-L5 commissioning process: factory testing, installation QA/QC and static tests, start-up and pre-functional checks, system or module SAT and integrated systems testing.

  • Review and coordinate test method statements, scripts, load profiles, acceptance criteria, sequences of operation and cause-and-effect coverage with engineering SMEs, contractors, OEMs and the independent Commissioning Authority where appointed.

  • Secure test prerequisites, including permanent or temporary power, load banks, thermal loads, cooling readiness, water quality, calibrated instruments, controls connectivity and safe working arrangements.

  • Coordinate electrical, mechanical and liquid-cooling systems, BMS, EPMS and DCIM, fire and life safety, security and ICT/OT interfaces. Align facility readiness with rack, server, cluster and platform delivery leads.

  • Use Omega365 as the system of record for commissioning scope, checklists, test evidence, digital sign-off, punch and NCR status, retests and readiness reporting.

  • Manage commissioning risks, blockers, changes and deferred tests. Escalate failed acceptance criteria and readiness gaps with clear evidence and recommended actions.

  • Prepare readiness recommendations, including RFC before L4, RFS following successful integrated systems testing and RFT after the agreed IT and service-validation scope.

  • Coordinate Operations training, O&M deliverables, handover, the final commissioning report and the outstanding-item register.

About you

  • Typically 5+ years of experience in commissioning or delivery of complex technical facilities, including responsibility for multidisciplinary commissioning.

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Energy Systems or a related technical discipline. Equivalent practical experience from commissioning complex technical facilities may compensate for formal education.

  • Strong working knowledge of power and cooling infrastructure, controls integration, functional testing, failure scenarios and integrated systems testing.

  • Experience leading contractors, OEMs and specialist test teams through clear plans, responsibilities, decisions and escalation, including teams without a direct reporting line.

  • The judgement to challenge test methods, assess evidence, manage cross-discipline interfaces and make clear recommendations on system readiness.

  • A structured, pragmatic and decisive working style. You communicate technical risks clearly and follow issues through to verified closure.

  • Fluent professional English, both written and spoken, and willingness to travel and work on site during critical testing periods.

  • Experience from owner-side commissioning in data centres or other mission-critical environments, modular facilities, GPU or AI infrastructure, liquid cooling or first-of-kind systems would be valuable. So would experience with Omega365 or comparable digital commissioning tools, Norwegian or another Scandinavian language and a relevant commissioning or project management certification, but none of these is required.

What success looks like

Within the first few months, project commissioning is governed by a clear and trusted plan, testing is prepared before site execution and readiness decisions are supported by complete, traceable evidence. Engineering, construction, suppliers, Operations and IT delivery understand their responsibilities and interfaces. Risks are surfaced early, defects and deferred tests are controlled and handover is completed without avoidable gaps between facility readiness and technology deployment.

Why Fossefall?

This is an opportunity to shape owner-side commissioning capability while Fossefall's AI infrastructure portfolio is being built. You will work across the physical and digital layers of high-performance AI facilities, influence how projects move from construction into reliable operation and collaborate with specialists across engineering, project delivery, operations and technology.

We are still small enough for individual judgement and ownership to matter. You will have room to improve how we work, contribute to critical delivery decisions and help build repeatable commissioning practices for future projects.

About Fossefall

Fossefall is a Nordic AI infrastructure company founded in 2025. We develop and operate AI factories powered by renewable energy, turning clean Nordic power into scalable, sovereign computing capacity for Europe, built in partnership with local communities, energy producers and technology leaders across the world. As a team, we are still small enough to know each other as people, and our culture is shaped by ownership, curiosity, warmth and collaboration.

Interested?

Make sure your CV is up to date for this role and tell us briefly why this opportunity is interesting to you and how your experience connects to what we are looking for. We review applications as they come in and keep the role open until we find the right colleague. Due to the nature of our business, background checks and/or security clearance may be required as part of the employment process.

title: Business Operations & Claims Specialist
description:
Om stillingen

Som Business Operations & Claims Specialist blir du en del av den lokale salgsorganisasjonen i Norge. Du vil støtte økonomisk administrasjon og operative prosesser som bidrar til at virksomheten og forhandlernettverket fungerer godt.

Du vil koordinere krav fra forhandlere, bonusordninger og salgsinsentiver, følge opp fakturaer og betalinger, samt støtte innkjøp og lokale administrative oppgaver. I tett samarbeid med forhandlere, salg, marked, økonomi, leverandører og hovedkontoret vil du bidra til korrekt registrering, oppfølging til rett tid og effektive arbeidsprosesser.

Hovedansvarsområder

Forhandlerkrav, bonuser og salgsinsentiver – fra et salgsperspektiv

• Administrere og følge opp forhandlerkrav, bonusordninger og salgsinsentiver i tråd med gjeldende retningslinjer.

• Kontrollere krav mot vilkårene for ordningene, underlagsdokumentasjon og salgsdata, samt koordinere godkjenninger med relevante interessenter og hovedkontoret.

• Følge opp manglende dokumentasjon, avvik og unntak med forhandlere og interne team.

• Holde oversikt over innsendte, behandlede og utestående krav, og sørge for korrekt registrering og avklaring innen rimelig tid.

• Være kontaktperson for forhandlere i spørsmål om krav, bonusordninger og salgsinsentiver.

• Utarbeide rapporter om krav og insentiver for salgsteamet.

• Bidra til korrekt salgsrapportering ved å kontrollere relevante data og følge opp avvik.

Innkjøp og koordinering av leverandørfakturaer

• Koordinere lokale innkjøpsforespørsler og innkjøpsordrer, inkludert opprettelse og oppfølging, og gi Finance Business Partner informasjon om utestående forpliktelser ved behov.

• Støtte registrering av nye leverandører, vedlikehold av leverandørdata og innkjøpsadministrasjon i samarbeid med hovedkontoret.

• Koordinere leverandøravtaler og kontraktsdokumentasjon i tråd med hovedkontorets innkjøpspolicy og krav til godkjenning.

Lokal driftsstøtte og administrasjon

• Vedlikeholde korrekte kundedata.

• Støtte administrasjonen av kunde-, garanti- og kommersielle krav i samarbeid med hovedkontoret.

• Koordinere daglige administrative oppgaver for den lokale organisasjonen, inkludert kontorlokaler, leieavtaler, strøm og andre felleskostnader, telekommunikasjon og andre driftsbehov.

• Koordinere lokale driftsleverandører, kontrakter, serviceavtaler og fornyelser.

• Være et lokalt administrativt kontaktpunkt for leverandører og interne interessenter, og bidra til å løse daglige spørsmål.

Virksomhetsstøtte og prosessforbedring

• Støtte Finance Business Partner og samarbeide med økonomiavdelingen ved hovedkontoret og andre relevante team om operative økonomiske og administrative spørsmål.

• Støtte Finance Business Partner og relevante interessenter ved revisjoner og etterlevelseskontroller ved å fremskaffe operativ dokumentasjon og relevante opplysninger.

• Identifisere og formidle muligheter for å forbedre arbeidsprosesser og dokumentasjon knyttet til krav, insentiver, fakturering og administrasjon.

Kvalifikasjoner

• Bachelorgrad i økonomi, administrasjon eller et beslektet fagområde, eller relevant yrkesrettet utdanning, er en fordel. Relevant arbeidserfaring kan veie opp for manglende formelle kvalifikasjoner.

• 2–3 års arbeidserfaring eller mer.

• Erfaring fra administrasjon, salgsstøtte, fakturering, kravbehandling eller en lignende koordinerende rolle.

• Gode organisatoriske ferdigheter og evne til å arbeide nøyaktig.

• Komfortabel med å arbeide med tall, registreringer og regneark, inkludert grunnleggende bruk av Excel.

• Evne til å følge rutiner, håndtere flere oppgaver og overholde frister.

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner og en serviceinnstilt tilnærming i samarbeid med kolleger, forhandlere og leverandører.

• Vilje til å lære nye systemer og prosesser, og til å stille spørsmål ved behov.

• Erfaring med forhandlernettverk, bilbransjen, krav eller insentivordninger er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

• Norsk- og engelskkunnskaper som er tilstrekkelige for å kommunisere med lokale forhandlere og internasjonale kolleger.

About ZEEKR

ZEEKR is a premium electric mobility brand within Geely Holding Group, combining advanced technology with Scandinavian design. As we continue to develop our business in Norway through a dealer model, we are looking for a Business Operations & Claims Specialist to support our local sales organisation.

The Role

As Business Operations & Claims Specialist, you will be part of the local sales organisation in Norway, supporting the financial administration and operational processes that enable the business and dealer network to run smoothly.

You will coordinate dealer claims, bonus schemes and sales incentives, follow up on invoices and payments, and support procurement and local administrative activities. Working closely with dealers, Sales, Marketing, Finance, suppliers and HQ, you will help ensure accurate records, timely follow-up and effective ways of working.

Key Responsibilities

Dealer Claims, Bonuses & Sales Incentives from a Sales perspective

• Administer and follow up on dealer claims, bonus schemes and sales incentives in accordance with applicable guidelines.

• Review claims against scheme terms, supporting documentation and sales data, and coordinate approvals with relevant stakeholders and HQ.

• Follow up on missing documentation, discrepancies and exceptions with dealers and internal teams.

• Track submitted, processed and outstanding claims, ensuring accurate records and timely resolution.

• Act as a point of contact for dealers on claims, bonus schemes and sales incentives.

• Prepare claims and incentive reports for the Sales team.

• Support accurate sales reporting by checking relevant data and following up on discrepancies.

Procurement & Supplier Invoice Coordination

• Coordinate local purchase requests and purchase orders, including creation and tracking, and provide information on outstanding commitments to the Finance Business Partner as needed

• Support vendor onboarding, supplier master data and procurement administration in coordination with HQ.

• Coordinate supplier agreements and contract documentation in line with HQ procurement policies and approval requirements.

Local Operations & Administrative Support

• Maintain accurate customer master data.

• Support the administration of customer, warranty and commercial claims in coordination with HQ.

• Coordinate day-to-day administration for the local organisation, including office facilities, leases, utilities, telecommunications and other operational needs.

• Coordinate local operational suppliers, contracts, service agreements and renewals.

• Act as a local administrative point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders, helping resolve day-to-day issues.

Business Support & Process Improvements

• Support the Finance Business Partner and coordinate with HQ Finance and other relevant teams on operational financial and administrative matters.

• Support the Finance Business Partner and relevant stakeholders during audits and compliance reviews by providing operational documentation and records.

• Identify and communicate opportunities to improve operational processes and documentation related to claims, incentives, invoicing and administration.

Qualifications

• Bsc. degree in business administration, finance or a related field or relevant vocational training is an advantage. Relevant work experience may be considered instead of formal qualifications.

• 2-3+ years of work experience.

• Experience in administration, sales support, invoicing, claims handling or a similar coordination role.

• Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Comfortable working with numbers, records and spreadsheets, including basic Excel.

• Ability to follow procedures, manage several tasks and meet deadlines.

• Clear communication skills and a service-minded approach when working with colleagues, dealers and suppliers.

• Willingness to learn new systems and processes and ask questions when needed.

• Experience with dealer networks, automotive businesses, claims or incentive schemes is an advantage, but not required.

• Norwegian and English language skills appropriate for communicating with local dealers and international colleagues.

Please submit your CV in English

To thrive at Zeekr we believe that you have the courage to lead with trust and care and you don’t mind getting your hands dirty. You are highly innovative and have a great ability to adapt and perform in a constantly changing, fast-paced, highly demanding work environment. Like us, you believe it’s important to have a passion to work in an international and multicultural environment with the desire and ability to embrace the diversity of people, perspectives, and styles.

Apply today, we will perform ongoing selection during the application period. We look forward to hearing from you.

Please note that due to GDPR regulations we can only accept applications sent through the recruitment system, not via email or other channels. We do not accept applications submitted by external recruitment companies. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

OM ZEEKR

ZEEKR er et premiummerke innen elektrisk mobilitet i Geely Holding Group, som kombinerer avansert teknologi med skandinavisk design. Vi fortsetter å utvikle virksomheten vår i Norge gjennom en forhandlermodell, og søker nå en Business Operations & Claims Specialist som kan støtte vår lokale salgsorganisasjon.

title: Norwegian Business Account Manager in Sarpsborg, Norway
description:
Reference: KVNO

About Sarpsborg

Sarpsborg is a city in Eastern Norway, just an hour drive from Oslo. The city has around 140,000 inhabitants. It's the place with the most days of sunshine in all of Norway. Within this beautiful city you can find amazing parks, great restaurants and a lot of cultural things to see and do. You don't have the big city energy like in Oslo, but everything you need you can find. So if you like the city life but also need to escape that and take a hike in beautiful nature, Sarpsborg may be the perfect place for you. And we are offering a job for Norwegian speakers here!

Click here to read more about moving to Norway.

The job

Start working for a a Norwegian technology company that makes new home sales smarter. They develop a SaaS platform that brings together the entire sales and marketing journey in one place: from project pages and home selectors to digital advertising, options and customer follow-up. This way, home developers, prefabricated house suppliers and brokers get shorter sales times, smarter processes and more for their marketing budget.

They are Norway's largest player in prefabricated houses, cabins and small and medium-sized housing projects, and are also growing rapidly among the larger developers. Today, the platform has over 10,000 housing units with a total value of more than 50 billion kroner. Now, they are going to grow further and are looking for a Norwegian Business Account Executive.

Your job is to drive new sales in the Nordic market. You will prospect, open doors and handle the entire sales process from first contact to signing. Current target companies are small medium property building new houses (real estate buyers rarely). The leads are provided from a very large database-excel sheet. You will do 50 calls a week on average. An average deal size is 42k NO krone, with a sales target of 3 million NO Krone per year. The average duration of a sales cycle is 65 days + Account management for 12 months (for revenue recognition purposes).

Key responsibilities within this job:

  • Be responsible for new sales in a defined Nordic segment

  • Manage the entire sales process from prospecting, qualification, needs assessment, demos/presentations, negotiation, to signing

title: CSA QAQC Manager
description:
Role Overview

Provide regional quality leadership for Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) works across multiple data center projects. Reporting to the Head of Quality, the role establishes consistent quality practices, checks their implementation through site audits and surveillance, and verifies that findings are properly closed.

Work with project management, site QA/QC, engineering, package teams and subcontractors to prevent recurring defects, reduce rework and maintain the inspection and test evidence needed for area handover and project completion.

Scope

  • Cover CSA works and associated quality records across the assigned regional portfolio, including new build, fit-out and external works.

  • Maintain inspection templates, audit arrangements and evidence requirements aligned with CTS procedures, approved designs and project specifications.

  • Provide functional support to site QA/QC teams and intervene early where inspections, workmanship or closeout are falling short.

Key CSA Experience

  • Experience should cover the following areas, as applicable to the assigned project scope:

  • Civil works: earthworks, formation and compaction, piling and foundations, underground drainage and services, roads, slabs and hard standing.

  • Concrete: reinforcement, cover, formwork, embedded items and anchor bolts, placement, compaction, curing, test records, surveys and controlled repairs.

  • Structural works: steelwork and precast installation, connections, welding and bolting records, tolerances, grouting and protective coatings.

  • Building envelope: roofing, cladding, waterproofing, insulation, air and vapour barriers, seals and specified performance testing.

  • Architectural works: partitions, ceilings, doors, raised floors, floor finishes, coatings and workmanship standards.

  • Passive fire protection: compartmentation, firestopping, fire doors and structural fire protection, including installation traceability and inspection before concealment.

  • MEP interfaces: openings, penetrations, builders' work, equipment bases, access provisions, room condition and cleanliness for area handover.

Key Accountabilities

  • Own the regional CSA audit plan, with site visits and surveillance targeted at project risk, critical activities and recurring defects.

  • Audit subcontractor quality plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and inspection arrangements to confirm they are in place before relevant work starts.

  • Verify that site teams establish benchmarks and first-of-kind installations, obtain the required acceptance and use them to maintain workmanship standards.

  • Check that hold and witness points are planned, notified and recorded, and that required releases are obtained from the authorized parties before work proceeds.

  • Priorities work that will become inaccessible, including concrete pours, backfilling, enclosed cavities, firestopping and building-envelope interfaces.

  • Issue clear audit findings against the applicable requirements. Agree action owners and due dates and verify closeout using objective evidence.

  • Challenge recurring defects and non-conformance reports (NCRs), require root-cause investigation and check that corrective actions prevent recurrence across projects.

  • Escalate significant quality risks and overdue actions to project leadership and the Head of Quality. Recommend work holds where required under agreed project procedures.

  • Check that project programmers allow time for inspections, internal and client walkdowns, snagging, repairs and verification before area handover.

  • Report regional performance, repeat defects and emerging risks to the Head of Quality, with clear actions and support required.

Core Responsibilities

  • Run weekly or fortnightly quality reviews with site teams covering audit actions, NCRs, inspection status, upcoming hold points and handover constraints.

  • Sample installed works against current issued-for-construction drawings, approved technical submittals, specifications and accepted benchmarks.

  • Review material certification, delivery and storage controls, survey results, test records and equipment calibration, checking traceability to the work inspected.

  • Verify that concrete defects, water ingress, coating failures and other non-conformities follow an agreed repair process, with required technical approvals and inspection evidence.

  • Work with Mechanical and Electrical Quality Leads to check that shared interfaces and area handover requirements have clear inspection responsibilities.

  • Review CSA handover records in ACC/BIM 360 or the project document system, including completed ITPs, test results, as-built records and relevant warranties.

  • Coach site teams, share practical lessons and issue quality bulletins to improve inspection quality and prevent repeat problems.

Role Interfaces and Authority

  • The role provides regional assurance and functional guidance through project management and site QA/QC teams. Site teams and subcontractors remain responsible for carrying out the work, day-to-day inspections, corrective actions and maintaining their records.

  • Design decisions, technical submittal approvals and acceptance of design changes or remedial solutions remain with the appointed engineering and approval authorities. Hold-point releases and client acceptance follow the agreed project procedures. The CSA Quality Manager checks that the required approvals and evidence are in place and escalates unresolved concerns.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Degree or diploma in Civil or Structural Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical construction experience.

  • Proven experience in a lead CSA QA/QC role on complex construction projects, with data center or other mission-critical experience strongly preferred.

  • Sound practical knowledge of civil, structural and architectural construction methods, workmanship standards, inspection requirements and common defects.

  • Ability to interpret drawings, specifications and approved submittals, identify departures from requirements and support evidence-based resolution.

  • Experience planning and conducting construction audits, investigating NCRs, verifying corrective actions and reporting trends across projects.

  • Working knowledge of quality management systems and ISO 9001 principles. Internal or Lead Auditor training, or equivalent, is desirable.

  • Confident using ACC/BIM 360 or equivalent systems for inspections, issues, document control and handover evidence.

  • Clear communication and the confidence to challenge weak evidence, coach site teams and follow actions through to verified closure.

  • Experience across multiple sites or international projects is desirable.

Measures of Success

  • Audit actions and NCRs closed within agreed dates, supported by verified evidence.

  • Fewer repeat defects and improved inspection acceptance at the first submission.

  • Required inspections and hold-point releases completed before works are covered or progressed.

  • Complete, traceable CSA handover records and fewer outstanding quality issues at area handover.

title: Job i Portugal i 2027 med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi
description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi mangler løbende medarbejdere i 2027.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

title: Rušňovodiči
description:
• Riadenie hnacích vozidiel na vlečke.
• Vykonávanie obsluhu lokomotívy na vlečke.
• Kontrolovanie technického stavu hnacieho vozidla pred jazdou.
• Kontrolovanie predpísanej rýchlosti a ostatných faktorov ovplyvňujúcich bezpečnosť jazdy.
• Pristavovanie vozňov na určené miesto.
• Povinnosť poznať a dodržiavať všetky predpisy vzťahujúce sa na výkon dopravnej služby na koľajisku.
• Povinnosť zúčastniť sa pravidelných i mimoriadnych lekárskych prehliadok.
• Pravidelne sa zúčastňovať dopravného, prepravného, bezpečnostného školenia a periodického preskúšania.

• Povinnosť splniť a vykonať všetky príkazy týkajúce sa výkonu dopravnej služby od vedúceho posunu a majstra - správcu prevádzky vlečky.

title: Majstri (supervízori) v priemyselnej výrobe
description:
Hľadáme skúseného a technicky zdatného kolegu na pozíciu výrobný majster – zástupca vedúceho prevádzky, ktorý bude zodpovedný za organizáciu, riadenie a kontrolu výrobných a opravárenských činností v oblasti železničného opravárenstva.

Hľadáme človeka s prirodzenou autoritou, praktickými skúsenosťami zo strojárskej výroby alebo údržby, schopnosťou viesť tím a záujmom o zvyšovanie efektivity, kvality a produktivity práce. Dôležitá je schopnosť prepájať každodenné riadenie výroby s princípmi Lean managementu, 5S a neustáleho zlepšovania procesov.

Náplň práce:

    Organizovanie, koordinácia a kontrola každodenných výrobných a opravárenských činností.

    Riadenie a operatívne vedenie výrobných majstrov, prideľovanie úloh a kontrola ich plnenia.

    Zabezpečenie dodržiavania technologických postupov, pracovných inštrukcií, kvalitatívnych požiadaviek a termínov.

    Dohľad nad efektívnym využívaním pracovníkov, strojov, zariadení, materiálu a výrobných kapacít.

    Spolupráca s vedúcim prevádzky, technológmi, oddelením kvality, údržbou a logistikou.

    Operatívne riešenie výrobných problémov, prestojov, nezhôd a nedostatkov v pracovných postupoch.

    Aktívne zavádzanie a udržiavanie princípov Lean managementu, 5S a štandardizácie práce.

    Identifikácia plytvania, úzkych miest a príležitostí na zlepšenie výrobných procesov.

    Sledovanie produktivity, kvality, plnenia plánov a efektívnosti výroby.

title: Čašníci a someliéri
description:
V Strachan Resorte v Ždiari nespájame len tradičnú goralskú pohostinnosť s prémiovou kvalitou, ale vytvárame pre našich hostí zážitky. Naša reštaurácia je známa skvelou gastronómiou, rodinnou atmosférou a dychberúcimi výhľadmi na Belianske Tatry. Hľadáme do nášho tímu profesionála, pre ktorého nie je gastronómia len prácou, ale srdcovou záležitosťou.

Náplň práce:

Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Aktívny predaj našich špecialít, prémiových vín a destilátov (radi ťa do všetkého zasvätíme).

Prestieranie stolov, udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na rajóne.

Práca s pokladničným systémom a hotovosťou/terminálom.

Komunikácia s kuchyňou s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý servis.

Reprezentovanie dobrého mena Strachan Resortu úsmevom a proaktívnym prístupom.Výhody:ubytovanie

title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

description: Pomocná práca vykonávaná pomocným vychovávateľom pri zabezpečovaní náhradnej výchovy detí, mládeže alebo dospelých občanov, najmä fyzická starostlivosť o deti, upevňovanie hygienických návykov, skvalitňovanie spoločenského správania detí,  mládeže alebo dospelých občanov, vykonávanie pomocných prác pri realizácii výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, sledovanie zdravotného stavu a výchovy, dohľad v noci  v školách a školských zariadeniach vrátane špeciálnych škôl, v zariadeniach pre pracovnú rehabilitáciu občanov so zmenenou pracovnou schopnosťou alebo v zariadeniach sociálnych služieb1. Hlavné úlohy a zodpovednosti•    Zabezpečenie nočného pokoja: Monitorovanie dodržiavania nočného pokoja ubytovanými žiakmi v určenom čase.•    Dozor a bezpečnosť: Pravidelné kontrolné obchôdzky po chodbách a spoločných priestoroch internátu počas noci.•    Kontrola vstupu: Kontrola uzamknutia budovy, okien a únikových východov; zamedzenie vstupu nepovolaných osôb v nočných hodinách.•    Reakcia na mimoriadne situácie: V prípade požiaru, havárie (voda, plyn) alebo zranenia žiaka okamžité privolanie pomoci a informovanie nadriadeného v zmysle krízového plánu.2. Konkrétne pracovné činnosti•    Evidencia: Vedenie záznamov o priebehu nočnej zmeny a hlásenie akýchkoľvek incidentov alebo porušení školského poriadku.•    Pomocná výchovná činnosť: Poskytovanie základnej asistencie žiakom v prípade náhlej nevoľnosti alebo inej potreby (napr. sprievod k lekárovi v akútnych prípadoch, ak je to vyžadované).•    Dohľad nad ranným budením: Pomoc pri zabezpečení včasného vstávania žiakov a ich odchodu na raňajky do školy podľa pokynov vychovávateľov.•    Kontrola technického stavu: Ohlasovanie zistených technických porúch (vypálené žiarovky, tečúca voda), ktoré si vyžadujú zásah údržby.

- prácu na plný pracovný úväzok v 12-hodinových denných a nočných službách,

- zohľadnenie vzdelania,

A ako bonus v službe chutná kávička.

- Poskytuje pomoc, podporu alebo dohľad pri sebaobslužných činnostiach, najmä pri osobnej hygiene, starostlivosti o ústnu dutinu, vlasy a nechty, obliekaní, obúvaní, stravovaní, pitnom režime, vyprázdňovaní a používaní inkontinenčných a kompenzačných pomôcok.
- Poskytuje pomoc pri mobilite, chôdzi, vstávaní, líhaní, presunoch a polohovaní a vykonáva ďalšie opatrovateľské opatrenia v rozsahu svojej odbornej spôsobilosti, individuálnych potrieb prijímateľa a pokynov oprávneného odborného pracovníka.
- Pri poskytovaní starostlivosti volí najmenšiu potrebnú mieru pomoci; činnosť, ktorú prijímateľ nezvládne ani s primeranou podporou, vykoná v potrebnom rozsahu a prijímateľa pritom zapája podľa jeho možností, rešpektuje jeho tempo, voľbu, súkromie a dôstojnosť.
- Sleduje telesný, psychický a emočný stav prijímateľa a zmeny významné pre poskytovanie starostlivosti; závažné alebo neobvyklé zistenia bezodkladne oznamuje príslušnému odbornému zamestnancovi alebo nadriadenému a zaznamenáva ich podľa interných postupov.
- V rozsahu svojej odbornej spôsobilosti, zaškolenia, poverenia a interných postupov vykonáva alebo asistuje pri meraní základných fyziologických funkcií, podporuje dodržiavanie liečebného režimu a poskytuje pomoc pri užívaní liekov iba v rozsahu dovolenom právnymi predpismi a internými postupmi.
- Pripravuje prijímateľa na lekárske vyšetrenie a podľa potreby ho sprevádza na vyšetrenie, ošetrenie alebo inú zdravotnú službu.
- Pri bezprostrednom ohrození života alebo zdravia poskytuje prvú pomoc v rozsahu svojej odbornej prípravy, privolá odbornú pomoc alebo záchrannú zdravotnú službu a postupuje podľa interných krízových a bezpečnostných postupov.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežných činnostiach spojených s vedením domácnosti, najmä pri plánovaní a realizácii nákupu, príprave a podávaní jedla, umývaní riadu, upratovaní, vetraní, starostlivosti o lôžko a bielizeň, triedení odpadu a bezpečnom používaní domácich spotrebičov; ak prijímateľ činnosť nezvládne, vykoná ju v potrebnom rozsahu.
- Zabezpečuje primeranú čistotu, hygienu, poriadok a bezpečnosť spoločných priestorov komunitnej domácnosti v rozsahu pracovných úloh a interných postupov, vrátane hygienickej manipulácie so stravou, bielizňou, riadom a opatrovateľskými pomôckami.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežnom živote v komunite a podľa jeho individuálnych potrieb ho sprevádza pri nákupoch, návšteve úradov, pošty, banky, zdravotníckych zariadení, školy, práce, kultúrnych, športových, voľnočasových a iných bežných aktivitách.Výhody:- osobné príplatky

title: MONTER/KA DIZALA
description: Mjesto rada: Slovenija (izaslani radnici) i Hrvatska Prednost imaju kandidati s iskustvom u montaži dizala. Zbog povećanog opsega projekata tražimo iskusne montere dizala za rad na projektima u Sloveniji, uz mogućnost rada i na projektima u Hrvatskoj. Pozivamo na prijavu i pomoćne montere s tehničkim iskustvom koji žele dugoročno raditi i razvijati se u području montaže dizala. Opis posla: • montaža dizala na projektima u Sloveniji i Hrvatskoj • izvođenje montažnih radova prema tehničkoj dokumentaciji i uputama • korištenje ručnih i električnih alata • suradnja s ostalim članovima montažnog tima • pridržavanje pravila i standarda zaštite na radu Koga tražimo? Za poziciju montera: • prethodno iskustvo u montaži dizala • sposobnost samostalnog obavljanja montažnih radova • dobro poznavanje i sigurno korištenje alata • odgovornost, pouzdanost i spremnost na timski rad Za poziciju pomoćnog montera: • poželjno iskustvo na montažnim, građevinskim, elektro ili srodnim tehničkim poslovima • sposobnost rukovanja alatima • motiviranost za učenje i napredovanje • odgovornost i spremnost na terenski rad Poslodavac nudi: • stabilno i dugoročno zaposlenje • organiziran i plaćen smještaj kada je potreban zbog mjesta rada • organiziran i pokriven prijevoz vezan uz rad na projektima • osiguranu radnu i zaštitnu opremu • redovita i stimulativna primanja • stručnu podršku i dodatne edukacije • mogućnost napredovanja unutar tvrtke Iskusnim monterima nudimo mogućnost preuzimanja veće odgovornosti na projektima i daljnjeg napredovanja prema poziciji voditelja tima. Ako već imate iskustva u montaži dizala i tražite stabilan posao na dugoročnim projektima, želimo vas upoznati. Ako još nemate iskustva s dizalima, ali imate tehničko iskustvo, znate raditi s alatima i želite naučiti posao, također nam se možete javiti.

title: Bliv en del af vores marketingsteam i Barcelona - Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist.
description:
Vi søger en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist til vores internationale kontor i Barcelona - Opstart den 7. december.

Har du arbejdet med salg, telemarketing eller marketing i mere end et år og er klar til næste skridt i din karriere? Eller brænder du for digital markedsføring, er kreativ og vil gerne certificeres som konsulent, der hjælper virksomheder med at skabe succesfulde digitale kampagner?

Hvis du er teknisk stærk, kreativ og udadvendt — og samtidig trives i et tempofyldt og foranderligt miljø — så har vi måske det perfekte job til dig.

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Med forståelse for markedsdynamik og strategisk tænkning styrker du system integrering og kundeloyalitet — med effekt og relation i centrum.

Skaber vækst og digitale resultater

Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Styrker kunderejser og partnerskaber

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

Dit ansvar:

  • Onboarding af kunder og opbygning af langsigtede relationer over telefon og videomøder

  • Udvikling af performance-drevne PPC-strategier

  • Proaktivt salg og kampagneoptimering

  • Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af kundedata

  • Rådgivning om digital positionering og annoncering

  • Forståelse for ROI og integration med andre platforme

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk og engelsk på minimum C1

  • Bachelorgrad eller relevant erfaring i marketing/salg/Telemarketing

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

  • Proaktiv og strategisk tilgang til kundeopgaver

  • Evne til at navigere i komplekse stakeholder-miljøer

  • Passion for digital markedsføring og forretningsudvikling

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav — hvis rollen vækker din interesse, opfordrer vi dig stadig til at søge!

Benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Flyttepakke med flybillet og indkvartering i privat studie

  • Privat sygeforsikring og sundhedsfokus

  • Bonus for at anbefale en ven

  • Certificeringer og løbende kompetenceudvikling

  • Arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og teambuilding

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger end Danmark

  • Kunst, musik, tech og kultur i dynamisk samspil

  • Fokus på trivsel og diversitet

  • Internationale brands og karrieremuligheder

  • Åben og inkluderende atmosfære

Professionel udvikling:

  • Indsigt i digital markedsføring og internationale arbejdskulturer

  • Specialiseret viden om Google Ads og online strategi

  • Fuld oplæring og adgang til certificeringer

  • Karriereveje inden for tech, salg og rådgivning

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med kunder fra hele Europa

Personlig vækst og karriere:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

Barcelona er stedet, hvor arbejde og livskvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

Du kan også booke en snak med os via dette link: Book et kald

title: (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Physiker/in)
description: As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.What you bring:- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. Leveraging Siemens’ expertise, resources, and its ecosystem of businesses and partners, customers are empowered to unlock the full potential of Siemens technologies. Siemens Advanta elevates customer engagements to an enterprise level, leading transformations through strategic insight and holistic solutions. With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. With this, Siemens Advanta develops repeatable, scalable and proven solutions that maximize customer value across the entire value chain. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Siemens Advanta operates through a global network of around 800 employees across 18 countries.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.de/careers) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (http://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/karrieren-entdecken.html)  – if you need further information on the application process.

title: Orderplockare till lagerverksamhet - Helsingborg
description: ArbetsuppgifterVi söker flexibla lagerarbetare för extrajobb inom e-handel i Helsingborg!Vill du ha ett flexibelt extrajobb där du får vara aktiv och arbeta i ett högt tempo? Är du en person som gillar praktiskt arbete, har god arbetsmoral och kan ställa upp när behov uppstår? Då kan vi ha rätt möjlighet för dig!Just nu söker vi flera ansvarsfulla och engagerade medarbetare till en av våra kunder inom e-handel i Helsingborg. Du kommer att arbeta i en verksamhet där lagarbete, noggrannhet och ett effektivt arbetssätt är avgörande för att det dagliga arbetet ska fungera.Tjänsten passar dig som uppskattar ett varierat lagerarbete och har möjlighet att arbeta extra när verksamheten behöver förstärkning. Eftersom arbetstiderna kan variera är det viktigt att du är flexibel och har möjlighet att hoppa in med relativt kort framförhållning. Arbetet utförs under dagtid.För att kunna söka tjänsten behöver du ha en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50 procent. Det kan exempelvis vara studier, elitidrott eller en annan anställning.Dina arbetsuppgifterI det dagliga arbetet kommer du att hjälpa till med olika moment inom lagerhantering och orderflöden. Arbetsuppgifterna kan bland annat omfatta:- Plocka produkter och packa kundordrar med stor noggrannhet.- Ta emot inkommande gods samt kontrollera och registrera leveranser.- Sortera och göra i ordning produkter inför vidare distribution.- Använda skanningsutrustning och registrera varor i lagersystem.- Säkerställa att försändelser är rätt märkta och ordentligt förpackade.- Fylla på produkter i lagerutrymmen och delta i inventeringsarbete.- Ta hand om kundreturer och hantera avvikelser enligt verksamhetens rutiner.- Köra truck vid behov, förutsatt att du har giltig truckbehörighet.- Hjälpa till med övriga förekommande uppgifter för att upprätthålla ett smidigt lagerarbete.Vi söker dig somVi tror att du är en initiativrik och flexibel person som tycker om att arbeta praktiskt och har en positiv inställning till nya utmaningar. Du är ansvarsfull, håller ordning på dina arbetsuppgifter och har lätt för att anpassa dig när förutsättningarna förändras.Vi ser gärna att du:- Har möjlighet att arbeta extra vid behov och kan vara tillgänglig med kort varsel.- Uppskattar ett fysiskt arbete där du är i rörelse under större delen av dagen.- Är noggrann, punktlig och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.- Har lätt för att samarbeta med andra men även kan arbeta på egen hand.- Klarar av att hålla ett jämnt och effektivt arbetstempo under intensiva perioder.- Är engagerad, pålitlig och har en vilja att utvecklas och lära dig nya saker.Praktisk information om tjänstenArbetsort: Helsingborg.Anställningsform: Extraarbete vid behov.Arbetstider: Dagtid.Startdatum: Enligt överenskommelse.Är du på jakt efter ett flexibelt extrajobb?Det här är en bra möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning med ett aktivt arbete inom lager och e-handel. Du får arbeta tillsammans med ett engagerat team och vara med och bidra till att verksamhetens dagliga leveranser fungerar smidigt.Låter detta som något för dig? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!Din profilKrav: -Gillar att arbeta i ett snabbt tempo och ta i fysiskt-Är arbetsvillig, punktlig och noggrann-Trivs med ett högt arbetstempo-Har god samarbetsförmåga och tar ansvar-Annan sysseltsättning på minst 50%. -Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i både tal och skriftExtra plus om du har:-Truckbehörighet A & B-Tidigare lagervana -B-körkort och bil, då det underlättar transport till arbetsplatsen-Vad vi erbjuder:-Ett extrajobb med möjlighet till fler arbetspass för rätt person-En arbetsmiljö med drivna kollegor och högt tempo-Värdefull erfarenhet inom logistik och lager-Intresserad? Skicka in din ansökan så snart du kan – vi håller intervjuer löpande!
