title: Hedge Accounting Expert – Group Treasury
description: Are you an experienced hedge accounting professional looking for an opportunity to influence how hedge accounting is applied across one of the Nordic region's largest banks?As a Hedge Accounting Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring that Swedbank’s hedge accounting framework supports both regulatory requirements and the bank’s risk management objectives. You will work closely with colleagues across Treasury, Finance, Risk and Markets and contribute to the continued development of how hedge accounting is applied across the Group.We recognise that few candidates will match every single one of the qualifications listed below. If you have solid hedge accounting expertise and are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply.In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:    Shape and develop hedge accounting methodologies and frameworks:    Develop, analyse and maintain hedge accounting methodologies, frameworks and practices for Swedbank's Treasury activities.    Ensure compliance with IAS 39 and IFRS 9 while aligning accounting solutions with the bank's risk management strategies.    Contribute to the development of policies, processes and controls, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.    Provide specialist advice and technical expertise:    Act as a subject matter expert on hedge accounting related to Treasury transactions, financial instruments and hedging strategies.    Analyse and resolve complex hedge accounting questions, translating technical requirements into practical solutions.    Monitor developments in IFRS and market practice and assess their impact on the bank.     Collaborate and influence across the organisation:    Work closely with stakeholders across Treasury, Finance, Risk and Markets to ensure alignment between risk management and financial reporting.    Share your expertise and help strengthen hedge accounting capabilities across the organisation.What is needed in this role:    Education and professional background:    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.    Experience from a large bank, financial institution and/or audit firm is highly valued.      Technical expertise: We are looking for expertise in hedge accounting and practical experience in several of the following areas:    IAS 39 and IFRS 9.    Hedge designation, documentation and effectiveness assessment.    Financial instruments and derivatives.    The interaction between accounting and financial risk management.      Analytical and problem-solving skills:    Experience analysing and resolving complex hedge accounting matters.    Ability to interpret accounting standards and translate requirements into practical, sustainable solutions.    Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to complex topics.      Collaboration and communication:    Ability to build relationships and collaborate across different functions.    Ability to build effective working relationships with a range of stakeholders.    Ability to explain complex topics clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.    A collaborative, pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.    Full professional proficiency in English is required, Swedish language skills are a plus.    Familiarity with general Treasury activities such as balance sheet management, interest rate risk- and FX risk management would be beneficial.With us, you can experience:    Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.    Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.    An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.    A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.    Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden."Join our team and...... become part of a professional and collaborative Group Treasury organisation where your expertise will have a meaningful impact. You will work closely with experienced colleagues across Treasury, Finance and Risk, contributing to the continued development of Swedbank’s hedge accounting capabilities and financial risk management. This is an opportunity to take ownership of and influence how hedge accounting is applied and developed across Swedbank.”Joakim Wande Hägge , your future manager We look forward to receiving your application by 03.01.2027. We will review applications continuously, which means that the position may be filled before the application deadline. Therefore, the job posting may be removed prior to the stated closing date.Location: Stockholm, SundbybergRecruiting manager: Joakim Wande Hägge We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role.We have made our choice regarding recruitment media and therefore kindly decline contact with ad sellers or sellers of other recruitment services.Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome.#LI-MM1#LI-Hybrid

title: R&D Test Engineer – Materials & Surfaces
description: Would you like to combine materials science with hands-on laboratory work and contribute to the development of more sustainable technical solutions? We are now looking for an R&D Test Engineer to join our client, a global industrial technology company based in Lund.We're looking for someone who enjoys working close to the technology and wants to combine practical laboratory work with analysis, documentation and reporting. This is an opportunity to gain valuable experience within an international R&D organisation and work alongside senior specialists in materials science.ABOUT THE POSITION:As an R&D Test Engineer, you will join a research and technology team focused on early-stage innovation and the development of new technologies and material solutions.You will contribute to a project investigating materials, surfaces and corrosion-related challenges in components such as pipes and heat exchangers. The objective is to evaluate alternative materials and technical solutions that can meet future regulatory requirements while supporting increased sustainability and cost efficiency.Approximately 70% of your time will be spent carrying out practical work in laboratory and testing environments. You will conduct tests and experiments, follow up on the results and ensure that the work is performed in a structured and reliable manner. The remaining time will be dedicated to analysis, documentation and reporting.You will work closely with the technical lead for the materials and surfaces area and receive guidance from experienced specialists with strong connections to research and academia. The role also involves collaboration with experts and stakeholders across the organisation, to whom you will present results and provide input for continued development.Your responsibilities will include:    Planning and conducting practical tests and experiments in a laboratory environment.    Investigating materials, surfaces and corrosion-related properties.    Evaluating alternative material solutions for pipes, heat exchangers and other processing equipment.    Following test plans and contributing to the development of relevant experimental setups.    Analysing and compiling test results.    Documenting methods, observations and conclusions in a structured manner.    Presenting results and technical conclusions to specialists and relevant stakeholders.    Ensuring that tests are reliable, traceable and repeatable.WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:    Holds a BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or a related field.    Has practical experience in laboratory work, materials testing or experimental work.    Has knowledge of material properties and how materials are affected by factors such as mechanical loads, surface conditions and corrosion.    Is comfortable documenting, analysing and reporting technical results.    Can work independently in a laboratory environment and take responsibility for conducting accurate and reliable tests.    Communicates fluently in English, both spoken and written, as you will be working in an international organisation.It is not a requirement, but considered an advantage if you have experience in:    Corrosion testing, materials characterisation or surface technology.    Developing or improving test methods through practical experimental work.    Designing and building new test setups, procedures or experimental configurations.    Statistical analysis and evaluation of experimental results.You may be at the beginning of your career, or have a couple years of experience from laboratory work of experimental work with material testing. We put great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities, and believe that you are practical, curious and detail-oriented. You enjoy hands-on work and are motivated by understanding why a material or technical solution behaves in a particular way.To succeed in this role, you also need to be self-reliant and confident in your practical work. You take ownership of your tests, work methodically and ensure that your results can be trusted. At the same time, you are collaborative, communicative and comfortable asking for support or discussing your conclusions with more experienced colleagues.ABOUT THE EMPLOYMENT:This is a six-month project-based employment, meaning that you will be employed by Friday and work on assignment for our client. There is a possibility of extension depending on the project’s progress, testing cycles and continued needs.ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:    Scope: Full-time    Employment type: Six-month project-based employment, with the possibility of extension    Start date: As soon as possible in early 2027    Location: Lund, SwedenApply by clicking the link below. Applications are reviewed continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.ABOUT FRIDAY:At Friday, we are passionate about helping people take the next step in their careers within IT and engineering, whether they are looking for their first professional role or already have several years of experience. By understanding what motivates each candidate, we match people with companies and opportunities that make them look forward to going to work.We value ambition and potential and actively promote an inclusive and unbiased recruitment process in which every candidate is given the same opportunity to succeed.Friday has offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Each year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and connect candidates with organisations ranging from global companies to innovative startups.

title: Manager, Tissue Field Service
description: Are you ready to lead a world-class Tissue Field Service organization?We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Manager, Tissue Field Service to lead our Tissue Field Services organization.In this key leadership role, you will be responsible for managing a team of Field Service Engineers, Specialists, and Technicians supporting our Tissue customers mainly throughout EMEA region but also worldwide. You will have direct responsibility for field personnel based in Karlstad (Sweden) as well as other strategic Tissue Service locations across the EMEA region.You will ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality service delivery while driving operational excellence, employee development, customer satisfaction, and business growth. Working closely with Sales, Project Management, Performance Centers, Product Management, and regional Operations teams, you will play a critical role in strengthening Valmet’s position as the preferred service partner for Tissue producers.Primary Location: Karlstad (Sweden) or Darwen (UK).Your responsibilitiesIn your daily work, you will:    Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Service Engineers, Specialists, and Technicians located in Karlstad and other key EMEA service hubs.    Drive a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with Valmet's safety standards, policies, and customer site requirements.    Manage resource planning, workforce allocation, and competence development to ensure efficient execution of field service activities.    Ensure successful delivery of maintenance services, shutdowns, audits, inspections, troubleshooting assignments, machine upgrades, commissioning activities, and technical improvement projects.    Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and career development of field service personnel.    Define and monitor team performance through operational KPIs, utilization, customer satisfaction, profitability, safety, and employee engagement metrics.    Collaborate with Sales organizations to identify service opportunities, support customer development activities, and contribute to business growth targets.    Support quotation activities by providing technical expertise, resource estimations, and execution strategies for service projects.    Ensure effective coordination between Field Services, Project Teams, Performance Centers, Engineering, and Product Organizations.    Drive standardization and continuous improvement of service processes, methods, tools, and best practices.    Act as an escalation point for critical customer issues and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.    Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and customer focus throughout the organization.    Support the development and execution of strategic initiatives related to service growth, digitalization, remote services, and operational excellence.Expectations for youWe expect you to bring:    A degree in Engineering or equivalent technical experience.    Several years of experience in industrial field services, maintenance, tissue production, project management, or related service operations.    Proven experience in people leadership, team development, and performance management.    Good knowledge of Tissue production technologies, maintenance practices, and customer operations.    Experience managing multicultural teams and working within an international business environment.    Strong business acumen and understanding of service profitability, resource management, and customer value creation.    Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.    Ability to prioritize activities and make decisions in dynamic and fast-paced environments.    Experience with ERP, resource planning, and service management systems.    Fluency in English; additional languages are considered an asset.    Limited travel within the EMEA region could be needed, primarily team leadership and key operational activities.To succeed in this roleTo succeed in this position, you are a people-oriented leader who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent leadership and business management capabilities.You know how to motivate teams, develop talent, and create an environment where safety, collaboration, accountability, and customer focus are embedded in everyday work. You are comfortable balancing operational priorities with long-term strategic objectives and can effectively lead teams operating across multiple countries and cultures.You excel at building strong relationships with customers, colleagues, and stakeholders while maintaining a clear focus on execution, continuous improvement, and business results. Your leadership creates trust and engagement, enabling teams to consistently deliver exceptional service experiences and operational excellence.Additional informationDid we catch your interest? If you need any more information, please contact: Raffaele Malutta, Tissue Machines Field Services Senior Manager: raffaele.malutta@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.If you are interested in becoming part of the team, you can apply by December 11th, 2026, by filling in our online application form.For positions with people leadership responsibilities in Sweden, delegated Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) responsibilities form an integral part of the role. Relevant information will be shared and discussed during the recruitment process.We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.   We kindly decline any assistance from recruitment and staffing agencies.

title: People & Culture Coordinator (P/T Student Role)
description: The role - People & Culture Coordinator (part-time student role)Are you studying HR, psychology, business or a related field and looking for an opportunity to put what you're learning into practice alongside your studies?As our People & Culture Coordinator, you'll gain hands-on experience across a variety of HR activities, working closely with our Head of People & Culture and the wider team. You'll be a friendly and approachable first point of contact for our MAGnificent colleagues, supporting them with everyday people-related questions and helping to keep our HR operations running smoothly.You'll also have the opportunity to get involved in some exciting projects, including the implementation of our new HR system, where you can help shape and improve our ways of working. You'll work alongside our Office Coordinator to plan and organise employee events, helping to bring our colleagues together and contribute to our fun and inclusive workplace culture.We don't expect you to know everything already! What's important to us is that you're curious, enjoy helping others and are keen to learn, take initiative and find solutions.Working alongside your studiesThis is a 12-month fixed-term position working 16 hours per week, with your hours spread across two or three days in our Stockholm office. We understand the importance of balancing work with your studies and are happy to discuss a working schedule that works for both you and the team.The People & Culture teamWe're a small, friendly and collaborative team working across our Stockholm and Brighton studios. Led by our Head of People & Culture, our team includes an Office Coordinator in each studio and our Talent Acquisition Manager.We work closely together to create a positive employee experience across MAG, and we're looking forward to welcoming someone who can bring fresh ideas and perspectives to our team.What you’ll be doing    Being a friendly first point of contact for employees with everyday HR questions.    Supporting the onboarding of new colleagues, from initial preparations to helping create a welcoming first-day experience.    Helping with the implementation of our new HR system, maintaining accurate employee information and supporting colleagues in using it.    Helping to coordinate employee surveys, wellbeing activities and diversity and inclusion initiatives.    Working alongside our Office Coordinator to plan and organise employee events.    Supporting employee relocations in collaboration with our relocation partner.    Exploring how technology and AI can help us improve our processes and ways of working.    Getting involved in other People & Culture projects, with opportunities to explore areas that particularly interest you.Your skills/experience    You're currently studying HR, psychology, business administration or a related subject, having completed at least one year of your studies and with at least one year remaining.    You're based in the Stockholm area and available to work 16 hours per week from our office.    You're comfortable communicating in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.    You're organised, reliable and take pride in the quality and accuracy of your work.    You enjoy helping others, building relationships and interacting with colleagues across the company.    You're curious and resourceful, with the initiative to explore solutions and figure things out.    You understand the importance of confidentiality and can be trusted to handle sensitive information with care and discretion.Nice to have (but not essential)    Previous experience in administration, reception, customer service or another people-focused role.    An interest in digital tools, AI and how technology can support HR activities.What you'll gain    Practical HR experience across a broad range of People & Culture activities.    The opportunity to take ownership of your work, with responsibilities that grow as your experience and confidence develop.    Support and guidance from an experienced People & Culture team.    A flexible role that complements your studies.    The experience of working in a creative, friendly and international games company.Perks and Benefits    Company mobile phone and contract    1:1 Mentor    Flexible working hours    Seasonal kick-off events    Gym allowance    Monthly after-work socials    Company-wide carbon offsetting and CSR initiativesAt MAG, we want all of our employees to feel valued, appreciated and empowered to bring their true selves to work!Our recruitment processes are designed to prevent bias and discrimination against people regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status or any other aspect.

title: Director Business Control - Vara Operations
description: Company description:"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."Job description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.    What you will do At Volvo Penta, we are driving the transition towards sustainable power solutions and continuously developing how we work through digitalization, new technologies and changing market demands. Vara Operations is an important part of this journey.   As Director Business Control, you will report to the Vice President Vara Operations and be a member of the Vara Operations Management Team.   You will lead a small team of highly skilled business controllers and act as a trusted business partner to the site leadership team. Together with your team, you will turn data into insights, support and challenge the organization, and contribute to informed decisions that strengthen both current performance and long-term success.   Your responsibilities include business planning, forecasting, financial follow-up, performance management, investment evaluations, business cases and resource allocation. You will also contribute to continuous improvement and productivity development across the site.   A key part of the role is to strengthen data-driven decision-making and accelerate the use of analytics and digital tools, while actively contributing to the strategic development of Vara Operations.   Your future team Vara Operations is a key part of Volvo Penta’s global industrial network, delivering products and solutions to customers around the world while continuously developing its capabilities for the future.   You will lead the Business Control team and work closely with the Vara Operations Management Team and leaders across the site.   The team plays an important role in connecting financial performance with operational priorities and business decisions. Together, you will support the organization with insights, analysis and financial guidance that contribute to improved performance and long-term development.   Who are you? You are a collaborative and engaging leader with strong business acumen and a genuine interest in developing both people and performance. You enjoy understanding the story behind the numbers and turning insights into meaningful action.   We believe you have:        Proven leadership experience within Finance or Business Control     Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect financial performance with business strategy     Experience from a manufacturing environment and working close to the business     Experience driving change, continuous improvement and performance development     A university degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field    You build trust through collaboration, communication and stakeholder engagement. You are motivated by helping both people and organizations perform at their best and are comfortable turning complexity into clear priorities and actions.   What’s in it for you? This is an opportunity to lead a skilled team and influence both strategic and operational decisions within Vara Operations.   You will work close to the business and have the opportunity to contribute to performance development, investments, productivity and the continued development of data-driven ways of working.   At Volvo Penta, you will be part of an organization built on innovation, trust and collaboration, where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop and contribute to our continued success.   Ready for the next move? If you want to combine people leadership, business control and strategic influence in a manufacturing environment, we look forward to receiving your application.   For further information, please contact:   Jenny Johansson Hägg, Vice President Vara Operations, 0735 58 81 24   Roberto Kellett, Director People & Culture Vara Operations, 0728 62 31 76   Last application date: December 6   We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.   Who we are and what we believe in  We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Volvo Penta, a world-leading supplier of engines and complete drive systems for marine and industrial applications, you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who works with passion, trust each other and embraces change to stay ahead. We make our customers win.

title: Legal Counsel to Spiideo
description: Spiideo is a leading sports tech company headquartered in the heart of Malmö. We help spread the joy of sports through cutting-edge, cloud-based sports video technology used for video recording, data analysis and broadcasting. Our customers are clubs, leagues and media companies all over the globe. We are around 200 people in multiple locations. We are now looking to strengthen our team at our Lilla Torg office in Malmö with a highly skilled Legal Counsel.About the roleIn the role of Legal Counsel, you will be supporting the organization with a wide range of legal matters, with a special focus on our customer contracts. You will have the unique opportunity to shape the legal function’s development and be part of establishing new routines and processes. You will primarily support the commercial organization while collaborating closely with colleagues throughout the company, including product development and marketing. As a trusted legal advisor, you will work closely with the management team and key stakeholders across the business.The role includes the following key responsibilities:    Provide legal advice on customer contracts, including redlining and negotiations with customers across multiple international markets;    Develop, maintain and continuously improve contract templates and negotiation playbooks to support efficient commercial contracting;    Develop and maintain a robust structure for our terms and conditions and implement a platform to manage contracts, track versions, and ensure compliance;    Ensure that all customer contracts are up-to-date and reflect the latest product developments;    Collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide legal advice in relation to the release of new product versions; and    Support the business on a variety of general legal matters, including questions related to privacy, intellectual property and trademarks when required.You will report to the CFO and work with colleagues across the globe. Our office is located at Lilla Torg in the city center of Malmö within walking distance of the train station.What we are looking forWe are looking for a legal professional with at least five years of experience as an associate at a reputable law firm or as in-house counsel at a tech company. You hold a Master of Laws (LL.M.), a Master's degree in Business and Commercial Law, or an equivalent legal degree. You have strong expertise in drafting and negotiating commercial contracts. Previous experience negotiating SaaS agreements is considered an advantage. You also have a great ability to develop and implement legal structures and processes. With a collaborative mindset and a high degree of independence, you build strong relationships with stakeholders across different markets and jurisdictions. Experience gained abroad or within a highly international organization is a strong advantage, particularly if it includes experience from the U.S. market. You communicate with ease and credibility in English, both orally and in writing.To succeed in this role, you enjoy working in a dynamic and fast-changing environment. You are business-driven and solution-oriented, with the confidence to make decisions and provide clear guidance. You combine initiative and humility, work collaboratively, and build strong relationships across the organization.What we offer youWe offer a collaborative, supportive environment with opportunities for professional growth. You will have the chance to make an impact in a growing, international SaaS company and be part of a friendly and skilled multinational team.We believe that with a great team we can create magic! The thing we value most is working with talented people in highly creative and productive ways. By bringing great people together, we build our winning team and achieve extraordinary results. Working at Spiideo should be rewarding, fun and developing, yet challenging.About SpiideoFounded in Malmö in 2012, Spiideo has grown into a global leader in AI-powered sports video technology. Today, more than 4,000 organizations use Spiideo's solutions, including teams in the Premier League, NHL, NBA and Sweden's Allsvenskan. By combining cloud-based technology, video and AI/ML, Spiideo helps sports organizations capture, analyze and distribute content more efficiently. Learn more about Spiideo here: Home - Spiideo Contact and ApplicationIn this recruitment process, Spiideo is supported by Jurek Recruitment & Consulting. Please apply via the "Apply now"-botton. We review new applications continuously. Kindly note that we do not accept applications by email. For any questions, please contact Recruitment Consultant Linn Marthinussen by phone 076-002 69 41, or by email at linn.marthinussen@jurek.seJurek is a specialised recruitment and consulting firm that helps companies find the right talent within Finance, Legal & Compliance, Banking & Insurance, HR, and Business Support. Our experienced team combines industry expertise with a strong network to deliver accurate and long-term recruitment solutions. We work in a personal, quality-driven, and partnership-oriented way, striving to create the best possible experience for both clients and candidates.

title: Field Service Specialist
description: Are you ready for the next step in your career?Join Valmet as a Field Service Specialist within our Tissue Field Services Team.In this role, you will work directly at customer sites in EMEA and worldwide, performing maintenance, troubleshooting, audits, and start-up support on key sections of the tissue machine. Your expertise and customer-oriented approach will directly contribute to improved machine performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction.This position is ideal for someone who enjoys field work, problem-solving, and operating in dynamic and international environments. You will work independently or together with other Valmet specialists, representing our service excellence on site.Primary Location: Karlstad (Sweden) or Darwen (UK). Other locations within EMEA may be considered.Your responsibilities:    Perform field service activities on one or more tissue machine sections: Headbox, forming section, pressing area (including ViscoNip™), and reel.    Carry out inspections, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, equipment adjustments, and technical audits.    Support installation projects, start‑ups, shutdowns, and optimization activities.    Prepare accurate service reports, technical documentation, and improvement recommendations.    Collaborate closely with customer technical teams, ensuring clear communication and excellent service delivery.    Support other services or project activities when required (maintenance, upgrades, measurement tasks).    Maintain high safety awareness and follow Valmet safety guidelines during all site activities.    Represent Valmet professionally, contributing to long-term, trust‑based customer relationships.Expectations for you:    Minimum 5 years of hands‑on experience in Tissue Machine field with solid expertise in one of the following:– Headbox and forming section– Pressing area (including ViscoNip™)– Reel section operations and maintenance    Strong mechanical and/or process competence proven through field service activities.    Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues, even under time pressure.    Strong communication skills and customer‑oriented approach, with the ability to work in multicultural environments.    Flexibility and willingness to travel about 50% of the time (international and domestic).    Good command of English; additional languages are a plus.    Proficiency in basic reporting tools (e.g., Microsoft Office).    Valid B driving licence.To succeed in this roleYou bring solid technical expertise, hands‑on mechanical/process knowledge, and the ability to operate effectively in demanding on‑site environments. A proactive mindset, strong customer focus, problem‑solving ability, and clear communication skills will distinguish you in this position.We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviors that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:- Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through.- Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly.- Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety.- Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value.Want to know more?Did we catch your interest? If you need any more information, contact Raffaele Malutta, Tissue Machines Field Services Senior Manager: raffaele.malutta@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via e-mail.If you are interested in becoming part of the team, you can apply by December 11th, 2026, by filling in our online application form.We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.When everything works togetherValmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 18,500 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. title: Sous Chef till Mr.Bronck på Sheraton Stockholm Hotel

As Sous Chef, you will be responsible for the planning, preparation, and ensuring exceptional food quality, presentation, and timely service. You will lead and manage the kitchen team during service, uphold the highest hygiene standards, and maintain effective cost control. Main responsibilities:●       Manage the daily operation of our kitchen and stewarding teams, actively participating in service. ●       Help the head chef to develop menus as required seasonally to fit our different concepts and needs.●       Supervise the production of quality food products in the restaurant ensuring high standards are always kept●       Develop a strategy plan for the minimization of food wastage●       To assure the development and coaching/training all kitchen team members●       To oversee the daily ordering of the necessary food products●       To overview the HACCP control of our operation ensuring we are adhering to the set regulations●       Act on kitchen related guest requests and problems in a manner that follows the hotels vision and policies ●       Build and maintain a strong relationship with the service team Qualifications:You are a creative team player who thrives in a high-pace kitchen operation making exceptionally high-quality food. ●       You have at least 3-year experience working in similar position in a high-level restaurant or hotel kitchen.●       Creative personality who enjoys developing concepts and thinking outside the box.●       Experienced in developing high level menus.●       Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and manage a team.●       Ambitious and interested in working in a high-pace environment with great standards.●       Out-going personality who has an easy way communicating with colleagues and guests.●       Good sense of service and a genuine desire to exceed guests' and employees' expectations.●       You enjoy structure and have good organizational skills.●       High professional ethics.●       Luxury hospitality is your passion, and you have a genuine love for food.●       Able to fluently communicate verbally in English. Fluency in Swedish is a plus. What We Offer:A permanent full-time position following the 6-month probation period and we adhere to collective agreements.Great opportunities for career growth.A dynamic and inclusive work environment.Employee discounted rates at over 8,000 hotels worldwide. title: Technical Communicator - R&D
description: Your roleOur products are used by operators in the manufacturing industry around the world, 24/7. As a Technical Communicator, you play an important role in making our products easy to understand, safe to use, and accessible worldwide.You own the full information lifecycle for hardware and software products, from planning and authoring to publication and release. Working closely with R&D, Service, Compliance and UX, you create clear, user-focused product information for customers and service teams worldwide.This is a hands-on role where you write and publish content in DITA, support and coach fellow writers, and help shape how information is structured, managed and reused across our product portfolio. Some of your responsibilities:    Create and publish reusable DITA content, including user guides, service instructions, quick-start guides and release notes    Manage content reuse, product variants and publication structures in our Component Content Management System (CCMS)    Contribute to information architecture, including content models, metadata, taxonomies and tagging strategies    Coach and support technical writers in DITA authoring best practices    Coordinate reviews and approvals with stakeholders across R&D, Service, Compliance and UX    Contribute to digital content formats such as interactive graphics and animations when they improve the user experience  This role resports to Team Manager Product Information, R&D.Your skills and experience    Extensive experience in technical writing for complex hardware and/or software products    Strong hands-on expertise in DITA XML and structured authoring    Experience working in a DITA-based CCMS and managing reusable content    Experience coaching or supporting technical writers    Understanding of information architecture principles and content governance    Experience creating user-centered, accessible documentation and UI content    A bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field    Excellent written English Meritorious:    Experience with Schema ST4    Knowledge of Swedish    Familiarity with DITA subject schemes, iiRDS or SKOS Your job locationThis role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our office in Stockholm, Sweden (SE). Application processOur selection process includes interviews and skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us.

title: National Sales Developer
description: Take Ownership of Building Semin's Presence in the Nordic MarketSemin Group is investing in the Nordic market, and we're looking for someone who wants to be at the centre of that growth. As one of Europe's leading manufacturers of fillers, joint compounds and interior finishing solutions, Semin has built a strong presence across multiple European markets. We are now looking for a National Sales Developer to help establish and grow our business across the Nordic region.This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities and developing business in the construction industry. You'll be responsible for introducing the Semin brand, developing customer relationships and building a strong market presence across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. While your activities may initially be focused on your local market, your role will contribute to Semin's growth across the Nordics.If you enjoy being out with customers, developing new business and taking ownership of your results, we'd love to hear from you.The OpportunityYour mission is simple: Build Semin's position across the Nordic region.While your initial activities may be concentrated in your local market, your responsibility will extend across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. You will identify new business opportunities, develop relationships with key customers and distributors, and help establish Semin as a recognised partner throughout the Nordic construction industry.You will have significant freedom to shape your approach, influence market development, and create new business opportunities across the region. Working closely with colleagues across Europe, you'll play a direct role in strengthening Semin's Nordic presence and supporting the company's continued international growth.Your Responsibilities    Identify and develop new business opportunities    Build relationships with distributors, builders' merchants, wholesalers and key decision-makers    Introduce Semin's products and solutions to the market    Win new customers and grow existing business opportunities    Visit customers and maintain a strong presence in the field    Represent Semin at industry events, trade fairs and exhibitions    Develop and execute your own business development strategy    Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline    Monitor market trends, customer needs and competitor activity    Work closely with international colleagues to support growth and customer successWho We Are Looking ForYou understand how the construction industry works. You know how to build relationships, identify opportunities and convert them into business. Most importantly, you enjoy creating something new rather than simply maintaining what already exists.We believe you have:    At least 3 years of B2B sales experience within the construction industry    A proven track record in new business development    Experience working with distributors, builders’ merchants, wholesalers or related sales channels    A strong network within the construction sector    Experience managing your own territory and customer relationships    Excellent communication skills in English    Fluency in Swedish or Danish    A valid driving licenseMeritorious    Experience introducing products or brands into new markets    Experience selling fillers, drywall systems, construction chemicals, insulationproducts or similar solutions    Experience working in an international organisation    Experience working remotely and independentlyYou'll Succeed in This Role If You    Enjoy meeting customers and building relationships    Are motivated by finding and winning new business    Take initiative and work well independently    Are resilient and comfortable overcoming obstacles    Enjoy travel and spending time in the field    Have an entrepreneurial mindset    Want to have a direct impact on business growthThis role involves extensive travel and regular customer visits. Success comes from being visible in the market, understanding customer needs and building long-term relationships.What Semin OffersAt Semin, you'll join a successful European manufacturer while enjoying the autonomy and influence often associated with a much smaller business.You will receive:    The opportunity to build and develop a market with significant growth potential    Real ownership and responsibility    Direct access to international decision-makers    Product and company training in France    A dedicated mentor during onboarding    Support from experienced colleagues across Europe    An international working environment    A competitive compensation package    The opportunity to play a visible role in Semin's future growth in the Nordic regionLocationThe position is home-based and can be located in Sweden or Denmark.The successful candidate will initially focus on developing Semin's position within their local market while working closely with colleagues across Europe.Ready to Build Something?If you're excited by the opportunity to develop a market, build strong customer relationships and play a visible role in a growing international business, we'd love to hear from you.Please submit your CV in English.Join Semin and help establish the next chapter of our Nordic growth journey.INDGEN

title: Redovisningsekonom med start omgående

Rollen är framför allt förvaltande och passar dig som snabbt kan sätta dig in i befintliga arbetssätt, ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och säkerställa kvalitet och leverans.Du blir en del av ett redovisningsteam om fem personer som ansvarar för olika delar av verksamheten och rapporterar till redovisningschefen.AnsvarsområdenI rollen kommer du bland annat att arbeta med:- Månadsbokslut och årsbokslut- Kontoavstämningar- Upprättande av årsredovisningar- Fakturering och kontering- Kontroll av underlag och konteringar- Insamling och hantering av ekonomiska underlag från verksamheten- Rapportering och arbete i ExcelLämplig bakgrundVi söker dig som har:- Ca 2–5 års relevant erfarenhet inom redovisning- Erfarenhet av att självständigt hantera månads- och årsbokslut- Erfarenhet av att upprätta årsredovisningar- God erfarenhet av kontoavstämningar- Goda kunskaper i Excel- God systemvana och lätt för att sätta dig in i nya ekonomisystem- Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och leverera med god kvalitet även under korta deadlinesDet är meriterande om du har:- Kunskap inom K3- Erfarenhet från en större eller komplex organisation- Erfarenhet av digitalisering eller effektivisering av ekonomiprocesserPersonliga egenskaperFör att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är självgående och trygg i ditt redovisningsarbete. Du är prestigelös, hjälpsam och kommunikativ och uppskattar att samarbeta med andra samtidigt som du tar ett tydligt eget ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.Du arbetar strukturerat även när tempot är högt och är van vid att leverera mot korta deadlines. Framför allt söker vi dig som snabbt kan komma in i rollen, få grepp om arbetsuppgifterna och se till att arbetet blir gjort med god kvalitet.AnsökanFör mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Moa Werderitsch. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!Konsult hos SJRAtt arbeta som konsult hos SJR innebär att du blir en del av en dedikerad organisation med kompetens att ge dig perfekta förutsättningar att utvecklas både inom din yrkesroll och på ett personligt plan. Du får tillgång till vårt stora nätverk av intressanta företag och uppdragsgivare och därmed en unik möjlighet att ta din karriär till nästa steg.Vi på SJR bryr oss om vår personal och tillsammans med oss får du en långsiktig partner som ger dig trygghet och stöd. Vi är lyhörda för dina behov och du kommer att ha en nära relation med din konsultchef som stöttar dig i din utveckling. #Bildlänkhttps://media.sjr.se/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/konsult_interim_annons_60-1.png

title: Enhetschef/ Föreståndare
description: Är du en visionär ledare med djup förankring i vetenskapliga metoder och lagstiftning?Supporta Omsorg söker nu en föreståndare som vill leda och utveckla ungdomsvården in i framtiden. Genom en grund i vetenskapliga metoder vill vi bygga en förebild som andra inspireras av. Vill du vara med och skapa standaren för framtidens HVB?Supporta Omsorg HVB har tillstånd för 10 platser. Flickor och pojkar 16-21 år med missbruk. Ofta i kombination med psykisk ohälsa och neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar Om rollenSom föreståndare hos Supporta Omsorg har du det övergripande ansvaret för att driva och utveckla vår verksamhet. Rollen kräver en unik kombination av strategiskt tänkande, operativt ledarskap och god kunskap inom socialtjänstlagen. Din främsta uppgift är att säkerställa en trygg, rättssäker och evidensbaserad vårdmiljö för våra inskrivna.Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:    Leda och inspirera: Du har personalansvar och coachar ditt team mot gemensamma mål genom ett närvarande och prestigelöst ledarskap.    Kvalitetssäkring & dokumentation: Du ansvarar för att all dokumentation sker enligt IVO:s föreskrifter och att verksamheten lever upp till kraven i SoL och LVU.    Vetenskaplig förankring: Du implementerar och säkerställer användandet av vetenskapligt prövade metoder (t.ex. KBT, 12 stegs interventioner, MI, lågaffektivt bemötande) i det dagliga arbetet.    Samverkan: Du upprätthåller och utvecklar ett gott samarbete med socialtjänst, vårdnadshavare, skola och andra externa aktörer.    Verksamhetsutveckling: Du identifierar utvecklingsbehov och driver förbättringsprojekt för att Supporta Omsorg ska ligga i framkant vad gäller kvalitet och innovation.Ledningsjour mellan 16-08 vissa veckor ingår i tjänsten.Din profilVi söker dig som vill vara en förebild. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll och har en förmåga att skapa engagemang och stolthet i en personalgrupp.Krav för tjänsten:    Utbildning: Det är ett krav att du har en akademisk examen om minst 180hp inom socialt arbete eller annan högskoleutbildning som IVO bedömer som relevant för föreståndarskap.    Erfarenhet: Dokumenterad erfarenhet av ledarskap inom HVB eller liknande vårdform samt kvalificerat behandlingsarbete.    Lagstiftning: Mycket goda kunskaper i SoL, LVU och angränsande lagstiftning.    Personlighet: Du är strukturerad, kommunikativ och har en stark personlig integritet. Du ser lösningar där andra ser hinder och agerar alltid utifrån en sund värdegrund.    B-körkortVarför Supporta Omsorg?Vår värdegrund vilar på våra fyra värdeord: kommunikation, respekt, relation och delaktighet. Vi som arbetar på Supporta Omsorg strävar i första hand efter att skapa en god och förtroendefull relation till ungdomarna. För oss är det viktigt att ungdomarna känner sig trygga och respekterade. Att ha en öppen, tydlig och begriplig kommunikation skapar relationer vilket i sin tur leder till respekt för varandra. Vår verksamhet bygger på demokratiska värderingar. Supporta omsorg är en erfaren vårdgivare som varit aktiv i 12 år och Supporta Omsorg HVB etablerades 2019.Vi har en vårdkedja bestående av: familjehem, öppenvård, stödboende, behandlingsenheter samt akut HVB med 40 talet medarbetare fördelat på 4 orter.Återkopplingen från IVO speglar våran verksamhet och bekräftar ett väl genomfört kvalitetsarbete.Hos oss får du chansen att påverka på riktigt. Vi har korta beslutsvägar och en ambition att vara den mest attraktiva samarbetspartnern för socialtjänsten. Vi erbjuder dig en miljö där kvalitet går före kvantitet och där du får resurserna att bedriva vård som gör skillnad.AnsökanVälkommen med din ansökan (CV och personligt brev) via e-post. Urval sker löpande.Supporta Omsorg tillämpar registerkontroll enligt lag om registerkontroll av personal för arbete vid HVB-hem.

title: Personlig assistent till 27-årig tjej
employer: STALL 43 Ideell fören med firma STALL 43
description: Är du en gamingintresserad person som vill göra skillnad på riktigt?Personlig assistent sökes till ung kvinna med intresse för anime, gaming, cosplay och internetkultur.Vi söker dig som är en trygg, social och nyfiken som vill bli en viktig person i en ung kvinnas vardag.Kunden har autism och intellektuell funktionsnedsättning (IF). Hon har en egen värld fylld av intressen, kreativitet, spel, serier, anime och cosplay. Nu söker vi någon som vill lära känna henne på riktigt och möta henne i hennes värld. För att skapa balans i Teamet söker vi i första hand en kille men alla är välkomna att söka.Du behöver inte kunna allt om hennes intressen från början – men du behöver vara genuint intresserad av att förstå dem!Vi tror att du:    Har ett stort intresse för gaming, anime, cosplay, serier och internetkultur.    Är trygg i dig själv, lyhörd och har lätt för att skapa relationer.    Har humor, tålamod och förmåga att bjuda på dig själv.    Kan ta ansvar, hålla överenskommelser och vara professionell i din yrkesroll.    Har förståelse för att människor fungerar olika och att kommunikation och socialt samspel kan se olika ut.Du får gärna själv ha en NPF-diagnos. Det viktiga är att du känner dig trygg i dig själv, fungerar väl i rollen och kan ta det ansvar som arbetet innebär.Vad innebär arbetet?Din främsta uppgift är att skapa en trygg och meningsfull vardag tillsammans med Mimi.Det kan exempelvis innebära att:    Umgås kring spel, serier och andra gemensamma intressen.    Prata, skratta och dela upplevelser.    Följa med på aktiviteter och utflykter.    Stötta i sociala situationer och vardagliga sammanhang.    Vara en trygg person som finns där och bidrar till struktur när det behövs.Det handlar inte om att vara en traditionell kompis, utan om att kombinera en varm och naturlig relation med ansvar, respekt och professionalism.Vid fel ställda krav och utmaningar kan kunden bli mycket stressad, frustrerad och i värsta fall få ett autistiskt meltdown. Hon är inte utåtagerande men det krävs ett lugn och stabilitet av omgivningen för att ge henne det stöd och hjälp hon behöver vid dessa tillfällen, som kan uppstå, även om det är sällan. Teamet runt kunden hjälps alltid åt och stöttar varandra för att skapa ett tryggt nätverk.Vi erbjuder:Ett meningsfullt arbete där du får möjlighet att bygga en viktig relation och göra verklig skillnad i en annan människas vardag.Känner du att det här skulle kunna vara något för dig?Berätta gärna lite om dig själv, dina intressen och varför du tror att just du skulle passa tillsammans med den här tjejen.Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!Ansök via: teammimi.primass.seSkapa konto för att fullfölja din ansökan.

title: Area Sales Manager - Sweden
description: Signode is a leading global provider of transit packaging solutions, helping customers optimize their packaging operations through innovative products, equipment, and services.Area Sales Manager - Signode SwedenAre you a natural door opener driven by winning new business?For Signode Sweden, we are looking for a Area Sales Manager who is passionate about identifying new business opportunities, building relationships, and converting prospects into long-term customers.In this role, you will be a key contributor to our growth strategy, focusing on acquiring new customers across the Swedish market.About the RoleAs a Area Sales Manager, you will be responsible for actively identifying, developing, and winning new customers. You will manage the entire sales process, from prospecting and needs analysis to proposal development, negotiation, and closing.Key Responsibilities    Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities.    Proactively generate leads through prospecting, networking, and outbound sales activities.    Convert prospects into long-term contract customers.    Develop and present value-based solutions tailored to customer needs.    Drive opportunities through the full sales cycle to successful closure.    Maintain high-quality CRM management, including pipeline tracking and sales forecasting.    Provide market and competitor insights to strengthen our value proposition.    Work in a structured manner toward clearly defined sales targets and KPIs.Who Are You?We are looking for a result-oriented and persistent sales professional who is motivated by creating new business opportunities. title: Strategy Manager, Infrastructure & Construction
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description: Epiroc's infrastructure business serves customers in tunneling, quarrying, civil engineering, demolition, and recycling, and represents around 20% of Group revenues, or about SEK 13 billion. We are now sharpening our strategy for these markets and are looking for a Strategy Manager to lead that work: from the global view of where to grow, to the organic initiatives and acquisitions that get us there. Join our teamYou will join the Group Strategy and M&A team and report to the Group Vice President Strategy and M&A. You will work directly with Group Management, prepare decision material for key strategic initiatives, and collaborate closely with the Business Areas, divisions, customer centers, and group functions. Your missionYou will run projects from problem definition to recommendation, decision, and implementation. Typical work includes:     Define infrastructure strategies together with the business. Decide where Epiroc should grow across applications, customer segments, and regions, and with which offerings.     Strengthen our position with contractors and rental companies. These customers buy differently from mining customers, and winning them requires a different approach.     Shape the infrastructure M&A pipeline. Screen targets, build the deal thesis, and stay with the deal through valuation, due diligence, and value creation after closing.     Improve how we operate. Lead internal projects such as cost reduction, manufacturing and supply footprint, and operating model design, from the fact base to implementation with the business.     Assess the competitive landscape. Track global OEMs, attachment specialists, and new challengers, and turn what you find into clear actions for Epiroc. You will also contribute to the annual strategy process and other Group-wide initiatives. AI is a natural part of how our team works, from market analysis and target screening to building strategies and decision material. You will use it every day and help raise the bar for how we use it. Your profileYou are strategic, analytical and structured, with a hypothesis-driven approach and a strong drive for results. You enjoy moving between strategic thinking and practical execution, and you can structure an ambiguous business question and bring people together around a clear way forward. You have worked on infrastructure or construction topics, for example construction equipment, aggregates and building materials, contractors, equipment rental, or commercial due diligence on companies in these markets. You bring:     Master's degree in finance, business, economics or a related field from a top-tier university.     5-8 years of experience from top-tier management consulting and/or a corporate strategy function in a well-known multinational company.     Strong financial acumen and analytical skills, including market modeling, business cases and valuation.     Advanced, everyday use of AI tools in your work, for research, analysis, modeling, and storylining. You know where they add value, where they fall short, and how to check their output. Experience from industrial B2B companies, ideally capital equipment and aftermarket, is an advantage. You work independently and take projects from ideas to results. You have excellent communication skills, build trust, and can turn complex analysis into a clear storyline for senior and executive audiences. As this is an international role, you need strong written and spoken English. Swedish and additional languages are considered an advantage. Location and otherThis position is located in Stockholm (Sickla), Sweden. Regular international travel is part of the role. Why Epiroc?Infrastructure tools and equipment are changing faster than at any time in decades. Automation, digitalization, and electrification are reshaping how tunnels are built, how quarries run, and how contractors choose their equipment. For 152 years, Epiroc has helped customers in around 150 countries take on new technology. We intend to keep doing this for another 152 years and you will help decide how. We offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:     Global career opportunities     Learning & Development programs     Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)     Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being     Global Parental Leave Policy     Community involvement Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than December 13, 2026. We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience. For questions about the position, please contact:Otto Wetterström, Recruitment Specialist at otto.wetterstrom@external.epiroc.com Please note that due to regulations, we cannot handle applications received through email.

title: AWS Architect
description: Do you have deep expertise in AWS architecture combined with hands-on experience building cloud infrastructure? We are looking for an AWS Architect for a long-term consulting assignment, where you will take a key role in building regional AWS foundations for a data platform.About the jobThis is a full-time consulting assignment that lasts for 12 months. You will be employed by Bravura and work as a consultant with our client. There are good opportunities for extending the assignment.About the companyOur client is a global technology company providing. In this assignment, you will join a team working on establishing and deploying AWS-based infrastructure for a data platform. The team consists of specialists with complementary expertise, while you will contribute specifically with deep AWS architecture and engineering competence. Tasks and responsibilitiesAs AWS Architect, you will be responsible for designing and building regional AWS foundations. You will work hands-on with AWS architecture and infrastructure, using OpenTofu or Terraform together with GitLab CI/CD to create automated and maintainable environments. A central part of the assignment is establishing the AWS environment and supporting the deployment of the first US instance. Your work will span container infrastructure, storage, identity and access management, encryption, security and observability. You will also contribute to building fault-tolerant solutions and ensuring that the AWS environment can be operated, monitored and cost-optimised effectively. Your responsibilities will include:    Designing and building regional AWS foundations using OpenTofu or Terraform    Building and maintaining deployment pipelines using GitLab CI/CD    Establishing and configuring AWS services such as EKS, S3, IAM, KMS, VPC, CloudTrail and CloudWatch    Designing secure and fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure    Working with cloud operations, monitoring and cost optimisationEducation, experience and skills    Strong experience in AWS architecture and hands-on AWS engineering    Experience with OpenTofu or Terraform    Experience with GitLab CI/CD    Experience with Amazon EKS, S3, IAM, KMS, VPC, CloudTrail and CloudWatch    Experience with Python    Experience with secure data engineering    Experience designing fault-tolerant solutions    Experience with cloud operations, monitoring and cost optimisation    Experience or knowledge of Snowflake and Apache Iceberg integration at the AWS interface level We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking technical ownership within their area and can translate architectural requirements into working cloud infrastructure. You work independently when needed while collaborating closely with other technical specialists in the team. Since the assignment combines architecture and implementation, you are comfortable moving between technical design, problem-solving and hands-on engineering. title: Engagerad behandlingsassistent
description: Vill du arbeta med unga vuxna där beroendeproblematik, trauma och psykisk ohälsa ofta hänger tätt samman?Villa Hilleröd HVB är en del av Västerbos vårdkedja och ligger i Slottstaden i Malmö. Vi erbjuder vård och behandling för unga kvinnor och män i åldern 18–28 år med skadligt bruk, trauma och samsjuklighet.Vi söker nu en behandlingsassistent som har kunskap och erfarenhet inom beroendevård och missbruksproblematik och som vill bidra med både trygghet, struktur och behandlingskompetens i klienternas vardag.Om tjänstenSom behandlingsassistent arbetar du nära våra klienter och är en viktig del av den behandlande miljön. Du behöver kunna möta personer med komplex problematik och förstå hur exempelvis missbruk, återfallsproblematik, trauma och psykisk ohälsa kan påverka varandra.I arbetet ingår att skapa struktur och trygghet i vardagen, motivera till förändring och stödja klienterna i deras individuella behandlingsprocesser.Du arbetar tillsammans med psykolog och övrig behandlingspersonal i ett tvärprofessionellt team. Arbetstiden innefattar kvällar, nätter och helger.Vi söker dig som    Är utbildad socialpedagog, socionom, behandlingspedagog eller har annan relevant eftergymnasial utbildning. Relevant utbildning är ett krav.    Har praktisk erfarenhet av arbete med beroende, missbruk eller skadligt bruk.    Har kunskap om beroendeproblematik, motivationsarbete, återfall och återfallsprevention.    Har förståelse för samsjuklighet och samspelet mellan beroende, trauma och psykisk ohälsa.    Kan arbeta strukturerat och klientnära utifrån individuella behov och behandlingsmål.    Är trygg, relationsskapande och professionell även i situationer som ställer höga krav på bemötande och gränssättning.    Kan kombinera ett respektfullt och empatiskt förhållningssätt med tydlighet och struktur.    Trivs med nära teamsamverkan och bidrar aktivt till verksamhetens behandlingsarbete.Det är särskilt meriterande om du    Har utbildning eller erfarenhet av A-CRA, CRA, MET, MI och/eller återfallsprevention (ÅP).    Har arbetat inom HVB, beroendevård, psykiatri eller annan verksamhet med samsjuklighet.    Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med unga vuxna med komplex psykosocial problematik.Hos oss får du:    Ett meningsfullt arbete där din kompetens inom beroende och behandling verkligen kommer till användning.    Ett erfaret och engagerat tvärprofessionellt behandlingsteam.    Intern handledning och fortsatt kompetensutveckling inom bland annat MI och traumamedveten omsorg.    Möjlighet att vara med och utveckla en verksamhet där behandling, relation och struktur går hand i hand.    Friskvårdsbidrag och goda anställningsvillkor.Välkommen till Villa Hilleröd, för dig som vill arbeta nära klienten och samtidigt vara en aktiv del av behandlingen.

title: Drifttekniker (Fastigheter)
description: När vi är fler händer fantastiska saker. Därför skapar vi på Skandia Fastigheter rum som är särskilt utformade för samvaro. Vare sig det handlar om kontoret där vi lyfter varandra och verksamheten, förskolan där vi växer i leken, handelsplatsen där vi både handlar och hänger, eller hemmet där alla känner sig hemma.På Skandia Fastigheter sporras vi av vår höga kundnöjdhet, våra engagerade medarbetare och ett långsiktigt perspektiv på både hus och människor, i en verksamhet där öppenhet och förtroende är självklarheter. Det betyder att du inte bara får jobba i inspirerande miljöer med några av branschens vassaste (och trevligaste om vi får säga det själva) kollegor – du får även de bästa förutsättningarna för att påverka både din egen och företagets utveckling. Vi söker en serviceinriktad Drifttekniker till våra fastigheter i MalmöArbetet i Marknadsområde Malmö leds av ett engagerat team med stark gemenskap och en självklar närhet till hyresgästerna. Du kommer ingå i ett team med totalt tre drifttekniker och ha nära samarbete med teknisk förvaltare, kommersiell förvaltare och uthyrare. Arbetet innebär både självständig hantering av det dagliga arbetet i tilldelade fastigheter och nära samarbete med kollegorna för att tillsammans optimera effektiv drift och en god kundupplevelse från våra hyresgäster. Totalt arbetar 11 personer från kontoret i Malmö i olika roller där alla bidrar till hög kundnöjdhet och hög medarbetarnöjdhet. Vill du vara med i vårt team och bidra till att uppfylla vårt kundlöfte?Rollen som Drifttekniker innebär driftansvar för tilldelade fastigheter inom Marknadsområde Malmö. Du arbetar med underhåll, felsökning och energioptimering samt kvalitetssäkring av fastigheternas säkerhetssystem. Totalt omfattar området ca 130 000 kvm bestående av övervägande kontor, men med inslag av handelslokaler, samhällsfastigheter (vårdboende och skolor) samt bostäder och mobilitetshus. I beståndet finns ett 70-tal kommersiella hyresgäster och 140 bostadshyresgäster. Vi lovar våra kunder ett engagerat kundteam med god kännedom om respektive fastighet och våra kunders behov för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för deras verksamheter och boende. Där blir du en viktig pusselbit för att kunna uppfylla det löftet. Placering på kontoret är på Masttorget 6 i Malmö. Om rollenVi söker en serviceinriktad Drifttekniker där rollen innebär både självständigt arbete och arbete i team med planering, prioritering och kvalitetssäkring av dagliga insatser. I arbetet ingår en bred kontakt med hyresgäster och leverantörer där din centrala roll innebär att du blir en ambassadör för Skandia Fastigheter. Din insats bidrar till att våra fastigheter håller hög standard, med nöjda hyresgäster och optimala energiförbrukningsnivåer. Du ser det som en självklarhet att med din kompetens och ditt engagemang leverera hög service gentemot våra kunder och att den ständiga dialogen med dessa är en av grundstenarna i ditt arbete. Du har ansvar för att säkerställa en effektiv drift av fastigheterna samt ansvar för allmänt fastighets- och felavhjälpande underhåll inom verksamhetsområdet.Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter    Ansvara för effektiv drift och underhåll av fastigheter, inklusive felsökning, felavhjälpande, enklare reparationer och energioptimering.    Hantera och följa upp och återkoppla felanmälningar samt utföra systematiska ronderingar och följa upp serviceentreprenader.    Utföra kvalitetskontroller och arbeta med fastigheternas säkerhet (t.ex. brand, sprinkler, SBA, lås och larm)    Beställa och följa upp entreprenader samt arbeta med fastighetssystem för inrapportering och uppföljning.    Hantering av fakturor, beställningar och övriga administrativa uppgifter    Delaktighet i planerat underhåll och projekt    Vara kontaktperson och företräda Skandia Fastigheter i all kontakt med våra hyresgäster och agera bollplank och erbjuda efterfrågad service. Den vi sökerI denna rekrytering fäster vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Som vår nya Drifttekniker söker vi dig som är kommunikativ och tycker det är roligt att möta människor. Du är strukturerad, bra på att prioritera och förändringsbenägen. Du har förmågan att agera snabbt, ta ansvar och driva arbetet framåt. Vidare ser vi att du är kvalitetsmedveten, har en god problemlösande förmåga och har lätt för att samarbeta såväl internt som externt. Du har troligtvis några års erfarenhet inom driftteknik inom fastighetsbranschen eller motsvarande och har jobbat brett inom styr- och reglerteknik, VVS, fastighetsoptimering eller förebyggande underhåll. Vi ser gärna att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom driftteknik eller har annan teknisk utbildning med inriktning mot fastighet/drift/energi. Vidare har du goda generella IT-kunskaper, insikt om fastighets-IT, drivs av innovation och gillar att hålla dig uppdaterad inom teknikområdet. Körkort är ett krav för rollen, och du behöver tala och skriva svenska obehindrat samt behärska engelska på en grundläggande nivå.Låter tjänsten intressant? Då är vi nyfikna på dig!Vi erbjuder dig:- Ett kundägt bolag som arbetar för att ge långsiktigt och hållbart värde tillbaka till sina 1,5 miljoner kunder, tillika ägare.- Det stöd du behöver för att kunna prestera, samtidigt som du har förutsättningar för balans i livet.- Attraktiva förmåner inom bland annat försäkringar, bolån och friskvård.- En arbetsplats med generös och kollegial stämning. Vi är prestigelösa, hjälps åt och tar vara på varandras kunskap och erfarenheter.- Frihet och mandat, med ordning och reda. Du har stor frihet i hur du löser dina arbetsuppgifter och lägger upp din dag – men tydligheten och tryggheten finns alltid där i form av processer och ramverk, som vi hela tiden utvecklar tillsammans.- En kundfokuserad verksamhet – vi vet att nyckeln till ett starkt resultat går via en nära relation med kunderna. AnsökanVälkommen med din ansökan!Processen är redan igång och vi ser fram emot din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Urval sker löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan.
