title: Head Of Project Controls
description: Role overviewWe are looking for an experienced Head of Project Controls to lead Stegra’s Central Project Controls team on the Boden Project. The role sets the controls strategy, standards and governance for planning, cost, estimating, change, risk and reporting, and makes sure they are applied consistently across Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant.The Head of Project Controls will be the senior controls voice to project leadership, giving an honest and integrated view of time and cost performance, and making sure emerging threats are visible early enough for leadership to act.Reporting line and team structureThe Central Project Controls team sets the standards, processes and governance for project controls and delivers into each of the project areas (Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant).Reports to the Chief Finance Officer, Stegra Boden Project. Leads the Central Project Controls team, including cost, planning, estimating, change and reporting, and sets the standards to which the Area Project Controls Managers work.Key responsibilities■      Lead the Central Project Controls team and set the controls strategy, organisation and resourcing plan for the project.■      Define and own the project controls procedures, standards, WBS and coding structures, and governance that apply across all project areas.■      Ensure central standards are applied consistently in every project area, so that cost, schedule, change and risk data can be integrated and compared across Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant.■      Own the integrated scope, cost and schedule baseline for the project, and the process for controlling it.■      Provide integrated cost and schedule performance, forecasts and risk exposure to project leadership, executives and the board, with clear messages and the decisions required.■      Lead the monthly project controls cycle and challenge forecasts, progress and performance data that are not credible or not supported by evidence.■      Oversee earned value management and progress measurement across the project areas and EPCM contractors.■      Set the direction for project controls systems and data, including Primavera P6, Contruent, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Power BI, working with Stegra’s systems and data architecture teams.■      Ensure estimating, change control and risk management are fully integrated with cost and schedule control.■      Set the project controls requirements for EPCM contractors and hold them to account for the quality and timeliness of their data.■      Support funding and investment decisions with robust cost, schedule and cash-flow forecasts.■      Build, mentor and develop the central team and the wider project controls community across the project.Required experience and skills■      Minimum 15 years’ project controls experience on major capital projects, including at least 5 years leading a multidisciplinary project controls function.■      Proven experience leading project controls in an EPCM or owner’s team environment on a major project or programme.■      Deep understanding of planning and scheduling, cost control, estimating, change control, risk management, earned value and reporting, and how they fit together.■      A track record of setting up project controls functions, procedures and governance, ideally on a greenfield project.■      Experience presenting to executives, boards, lenders or investors.■      Strong leadership and stakeholder management, with the confidence to challenge senior leaders and contractors.■      Familiarity with Primavera P6, Contruent or similar cost management systems, and Power BI.■      Experience in steel, metals, heavy industrial, energy or process plant projects would be beneficial.■      Relevant degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying or a related discipline. AACE, APM, PMI or equivalent professional accreditation would be advantageous.Key expectationsThe successful candidate will give Stegra one integrated and trusted view of project performance, built on consistent standards across every project area. They will lead with integrity, challenge with evidence, and make sure leadership has the insight it needs to deliver the project safely and successfully against its time, cost and quality objectives.

title: Primary School Teacher
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Primary School Teacher--- Primary School Teacher======================**Teaching Opportunities – Bilingual Primary School** **Wisdom Tree Education \| Lausanne, Switzerland** Wisdom Tree Education is an independent bilingual French–English primary school in Lausanne. As part of its ongoing development and the enrichment of its educational offering, the school wishes to meet experienced and committed educators to complement its existing teaching team. We welcome applications from generalist primary teachers and subject specialists, with a particular interest at present in physical education, science and language teaching. Different levels of involvement and teaching commitments may be considered, depending on the experience, interests and availability of candidates. **The school** Wisdom Tree is a small, family\-oriented school with an educational vision spanning the primary years, from ages 4 to 12\. Small class sizes allow for individual attention, differentiated teaching and close relationships between children, teachers and families. The early years (ages 4–6\) follow authentic Montessori pedagogy, with AMI\-trained educators. From the age of six, children transition progressively towards more structured academic learning, retaining the independence, curiosity and intellectual engagement developed during their Montessori years. Our curriculum is based on the Swiss Plan d’études romand (PER), enriched by elements of the English and French national curricula and complementary international educational approaches. Our pedagogical approach incorporates spiral learning, enabling children to revisit and deepen their understanding of key concepts, with individualised progression according to their abilities and needs. Elements of Montessori and Freinet pedagogy, including individual work plans, self\-correction and mastery\-based assessment, encourage autonomy and responsibility within a structured academic framework. Our bilingual programme aims to develop genuine fluency and academic competence in both French and English. We place considerable importance on academic excellence, alongside the emotional, social, physical and personal development of each child. The school has a spiritually open, non\-denominational ethos, welcoming families of all backgrounds and encouraging respect, reflection and a sense of meaning. Located in a residential area of Lausanne, the school benefits from a private garden, an outdoor play area and nearby green spaces. Nature, outdoor activities and experiential learning form an important part of our educational approach. **Teaching and educational opportunities** We are interested in meeting educators who enjoy working within a small, collaborative school environment and who wish to contribute their own expertise and ideas. Alongside classroom teaching, there are opportunities to participate in curriculum development, interdisciplinary projects, enrichment activities and outdoor education. We particularly value teachers who are comfortable working with small, mixed\-ability groups and who can combine clear, structured teaching with an understanding of individual learning needs. Depending on experience and interests, opportunities to contribute more broadly to the pedagogical and organisational development of the school may also be considered. **Candidate profile** Candidates should ideally possess: * Recognised teaching qualifications or relevant specialist qualifications.* Experience working with primary\-aged children.* Strong subject knowledge and sound pedagogical skills.* The ability to establish a structured, positive and respectful classroom environment.* High academic expectations combined with patience, warmth and kindness.* A collaborative and practical approach to working with colleagues and families. A strong command of French and/or English is required, depending on the teaching area. Bilingualism is particularly valued. Experience in Montessori, international education, differentiated teaching or curriculum development would be an advantage, but is not essential for all positions. **Working at Wisdom Tree** The school’s size allows teachers to know their pupils well, adapt their teaching and follow each child’s progress closely. Educators have the opportunity to contribute to the development of the curriculum and teaching practices, working alongside colleagues and the founders in an environment that values professional expertise, initiative and constructive dialogue. We welcome applications from educators seeking an immediate teaching opportunity, a part\-time commitment or a longer\-term collaboration. **Applications** Please send your CV and a short covering letter outlining your experience, educational approach, areas of expertise and availability. **Opportunités d’enseignement – École primaire bilingue** **Wisdom Tree Education \| Lausanne, Suisse** Wisdom Tree Education est une école primaire bilingue français–anglais indépendante située à Lausanne. Dans le cadre de son développement et de l’enrichissement de son offre pédagogique, l’école souhaite rencontrer des professionnels de l’enseignement expérimentés et engagés afin de compléter son équipe actuelle. Nous accueillons les candidatures d’enseignants généralistes du primaire et de spécialistes de différentes disciplines, avec un intérêt particulier actuellement pour l’éducation physique et sportive, les sciences et l’enseignement des langues. Différents taux d’activité et modalités de collaboration peuvent être envisagés selon l’expérience, les aspirations et les disponibilités des candidats. **L’école** Wisdom Tree est une école à taille humaine, à caractère familial, dont le projet pédagogique couvre les années du primaire, de 4 à 12 ans. Les classes à petits effectifs permettent un accompagnement individualisé, une différenciation des apprentissages et des relations de proximité entre les enfants, les enseignants et les familles. Pour les enfants de 4 à 6 ans, l’enseignement repose sur la pédagogie Montessori, avec des professionnels formés à l’AMI. À partir de 6 ans, les enfants évoluent progressivement vers des apprentissages académiques plus structurés, tout en préservant l’autonomie, la curiosité et l’engagement intellectuel développés durant leurs premières années Montessori. Notre programme s’appuie sur le Plan d’études romand (PER), enrichi d’éléments des programmes scolaires anglais et français ainsi que d’approches pédagogiques internationales complémentaires. Notre démarche pédagogique intègre un apprentissage en spirale, permettant aux enfants de revisiter et d’approfondir régulièrement les notions essentielles, avec une progression individualisée selon leurs acquis et leurs besoins. Des éléments des pédagogies Montessori et Freinet, notamment les plans de travail individuels, l’autocorrection et les brevets de maîtrise, favorisent l’autonomie et la responsabilisation dans un cadre académique structuré. Notre programme bilingue vise à développer une véritable maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant sur le plan linguistique qu’académique. Nous accordons une grande importance à l’excellence académique, ainsi qu’au développement affectif, social, physique et personnel de chaque enfant. L’école s’inscrit dans une démarche spirituellement ouverte et non confessionnelle, accueillant les familles de tous horizons et favorisant le respect, la réflexion et la recherche de sens. Située dans un quartier résidentiel de Lausanne, l’école bénéficie d’un jardin privé, d’un espace de jeux extérieur et d’espaces verts à proximité. La nature, les activités en plein air et l’apprentissage par l’expérience occupent une place importante dans notre démarche éducative. **Opportunités d’enseignement et de collaboration** Nous souhaitons rencontrer des professionnels qui apprécient le travail au sein d’une équipe pédagogique à taille humaine et qui souhaitent y apporter leur expertise et leurs idées. title: PhD Student - Microscopy and Microstructure Modelling 100 %
description: Help shape the future of green hydrogen! Combine advanced microscopy and 3D microstructure modelling in an international research team to develop more efficient and durable water electrolyzers.PhD Student \- Microscopy and Microstructure Modelling 100 %**What you will be responsible for*** You characterize the microstructure of porous layers, catalyst layers and interfaces using advanced microscopy techniques (SEM/EDX, FIB\-SEM, optical microscopy) and analyse X\-ray tomography data.* You develop and validate stochastic 3D microstructure models and digital twins of porous materials based on microscopy and fabrication data.* You generate virtual microstructures with systematically varied material and fabrication parameters to explore and optimize porous layer architectures.* You calculate effective transport properties using numerical simulation tools (primarily GeoDict), establish microstructure\-property relationships and compare results with experimental data.* You collaborate with experimental research partners in Switzerland and France to characterize newly developed materials, investigate degradation and derive recommendations for improved performance and durability.* You contribute microstructure data and simulation results to the project's multiscale modelling and machine\-learning activities, supporting data preparation, optimization strategies and interpretation of results.**What makes you a great fit*** You hold a Master's degree in materials science, physics, engineering, or a related discipline.* You have a strong interest in microscopy/image analysis, computational 3D microstructure modelling, multiphysics simulation and are motivated to develop your expertise in these complementary fields.* You have basic programming or scripting skills ( Python or MATLAB) and enjoy analysing scientific data and exploring relationships between material structures and properties.* You are curious about emerging AI\-based methods and motivated to explore their potential to advance image analysis, microstructure modelling and scientific data processing.* You communicate effectively in English and enjoy working collaboratively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment.Additional qualifications (nice to have)* Previous experience with microscopy, 3D image processing, numerical simulation or microstructure modelling is an advantage. Fourteen institutes and centers ensure high\-quality education, research, and development with a focus on the areas of energy, mobility, information, and health.**The Institute of Computational Physics (ICP)**The Institute of Computational Physics (ICP) at ZHAW combines advanced image analysis, 3D microstructure modelling and multiphysics simulations with experimental characterization and data\-driven materials design. title: Primary School Teacher
description: ---base:  meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width,  title: Primary School Teacher--- Primary School Teacher======================**Teaching Opportunities – Bilingual Primary School** **Wisdom Tree Education \| Lausanne, Switzerland** Wisdom Tree Education is an independent bilingual French–English primary school in Lausanne. As part of its ongoing development and the enrichment of its educational offering, the school wishes to meet experienced and committed educators to complement its existing teaching team. We welcome applications from generalist primary teachers and subject specialists, with a particular interest at present in physical education, science and language teaching. Different levels of involvement and teaching commitments may be considered, depending on the experience, interests and availability of candidates. **The school** Wisdom Tree is a small, family\-oriented school with an educational vision spanning the primary years, from ages 4 to 12\. Small class sizes allow for individual attention, differentiated teaching and close relationships between children, teachers and families. The early years (ages 4–6\) follow authentic Montessori pedagogy, with AMI\-trained educators. From the age of six, children transition progressively towards more structured academic learning, retaining the independence, curiosity and intellectual engagement developed during their Montessori years. Our curriculum is based on the Swiss Plan d’études romand (PER), enriched by elements of the English and French national curricula and complementary international educational approaches. Our pedagogical approach incorporates spiral learning, enabling children to revisit and deepen their understanding of key concepts, with individualised progression according to their abilities and needs. Elements of Montessori and Freinet pedagogy, including individual work plans, self\-correction and mastery\-based assessment, encourage autonomy and responsibility within a structured academic framework. Our bilingual programme aims to develop genuine fluency and academic competence in both French and English. We place considerable importance on academic excellence, alongside the emotional, social, physical and personal development of each child. The school has a spiritually open, non\-denominational ethos, welcoming families of all backgrounds and encouraging respect, reflection and a sense of meaning. Located in a residential area of Lausanne, the school benefits from a private garden, an outdoor play area and nearby green spaces. Nature, outdoor activities and experiential learning form an important part of our educational approach. **Teaching and educational opportunities** We are interested in meeting educators who enjoy working within a small, collaborative school environment and who wish to contribute their own expertise and ideas. Alongside classroom teaching, there are opportunities to participate in curriculum development, interdisciplinary projects, enrichment activities and outdoor education. We particularly value teachers who are comfortable working with small, mixed\-ability groups and who can combine clear, structured teaching with an understanding of individual learning needs. Depending on experience and interests, opportunities to contribute more broadly to the pedagogical and organisational development of the school may also be considered. **Candidate profile** Candidates should ideally possess: * Recognised teaching qualifications or relevant specialist qualifications.* Experience working with primary\-aged children.* Strong subject knowledge and sound pedagogical skills.* The ability to establish a structured, positive and respectful classroom environment.* High academic expectations combined with patience, warmth and kindness.* A collaborative and practical approach to working with colleagues and families. A strong command of French and/or English is required, depending on the teaching area. Bilingualism is particularly valued. Experience in Montessori, international education, differentiated teaching or curriculum development would be an advantage, but is not essential for all positions. **Working at Wisdom Tree** The school’s size allows teachers to know their pupils well, adapt their teaching and follow each child’s progress closely. Educators have the opportunity to contribute to the development of the curriculum and teaching practices, working alongside colleagues and the founders in an environment that values professional expertise, initiative and constructive dialogue. We welcome applications from educators seeking an immediate teaching opportunity, a part\-time commitment or a longer\-term collaboration. **Applications** Please send your CV and a short covering letter outlining your experience, educational approach, areas of expertise and availability. **Opportunités d’enseignement – École primaire bilingue** **Wisdom Tree Education \| Lausanne, Suisse** Wisdom Tree Education est une école primaire bilingue français–anglais indépendante située à Lausanne. Dans le cadre de son développement et de l’enrichissement de son offre pédagogique, l’école souhaite rencontrer des professionnels de l’enseignement expérimentés et engagés afin de compléter son équipe actuelle. Nous accueillons les candidatures d’enseignants généralistes du primaire et de spécialistes de différentes disciplines, avec un intérêt particulier actuellement pour l’éducation physique et sportive, les sciences et l’enseignement des langues. Différents taux d’activité et modalités de collaboration peuvent être envisagés selon l’expérience, les aspirations et les disponibilités des candidats. **L’école** Wisdom Tree est une école à taille humaine, à caractère familial, dont le projet pédagogique couvre les années du primaire, de 4 à 12 ans. Les classes à petits effectifs permettent un accompagnement individualisé, une différenciation des apprentissages et des relations de proximité entre les enfants, les enseignants et les familles. Pour les enfants de 4 à 6 ans, l’enseignement repose sur la pédagogie Montessori, avec des professionnels formés à l’AMI. À partir de 6 ans, les enfants évoluent progressivement vers des apprentissages académiques plus structurés, tout en préservant l’autonomie, la curiosité et l’engagement intellectuel développés durant leurs premières années Montessori. Notre programme s’appuie sur le Plan d’études romand (PER), enrichi d’éléments des programmes scolaires anglais et français ainsi que d’approches pédagogiques internationales complémentaires. Notre démarche pédagogique intègre un apprentissage en spirale, permettant aux enfants de revisiter et d’approfondir régulièrement les notions essentielles, avec une progression individualisée selon leurs acquis et leurs besoins. Des éléments des pédagogies Montessori et Freinet, notamment les plans de travail individuels, l’autocorrection et les brevets de maîtrise, favorisent l’autonomie et la responsabilisation dans un cadre académique structuré. Notre programme bilingue vise à développer une véritable maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant sur le plan linguistique qu’académique. Nous accordons une grande importance à l’excellence académique, ainsi qu’au développement affectif, social, physique et personnel de chaque enfant. L’école s’inscrit dans une démarche spirituellement ouverte et non confessionnelle, accueillant les familles de tous horizons et favorisant le respect, la réflexion et la recherche de sens. Située dans un quartier résidentiel de Lausanne, l’école bénéficie d’un jardin privé, d’un espace de jeux extérieur et d’espaces verts à proximité. La nature, les activités en plein air et l’apprentissage par l’expérience occupent une place importante dans notre démarche éducative. **Opportunités d’enseignement et de collaboration** Nous souhaitons rencontrer des professionnels qui apprécient le travail au sein d’une équipe pédagogique à taille humaine et qui souhaitent y apporter leur expertise et leurs idées. Au\-delà de l’enseignement en classe, différentes possibilités de participation au développement des programmes, à des projets interdisciplinaires, à des activités d’enrichissement et à l’enseignement en plein air peuvent être envisagées. Nous apprécions particulièrement les enseignants à l’aise avec des groupes à petits effectifs et de niveaux différents, capables d’associer un enseignement clair et structuré à une prise en compte des besoins individuels des enfants. Selon l’expérience et les aspirations des candidats, une participation plus large au développement pédagogique et organisationnel de l’école pourra également être envisagée. **Profil recherché** Les candidats disposeront idéalement : * De qualifications reconnues dans l’enseignement ou dans leur domaine de spécialisation.* D’une expérience auprès d’enfants d’âge primaire.* De solides connaissances disciplinaires et compétences pédagogiques.* De la capacité à instaurer un cadre de classe structuré, positif et respectueux.* D’exigences académiques élevées, associées à la patience et à la bienveillance.* D’un esprit collaboratif et d’une approche pragmatique dans les relations avec les collègues et les familles. Une très bonne maîtrise du français et/ou de l’anglais est requise, selon le domaine d’enseignement. Le bilinguisme constitue un atout particulièrement apprécié. Une expérience en pédagogie Montessori, dans l’enseignement international, la différenciation pédagogique ou le développement de programmes scolaires serait un avantage, sans être indispensable pour tous les postes. **Travailler à Wisdom Tree** La taille de l’école permet aux enseignants de bien connaître leurs élèves, d’adapter leur enseignement et de suivre attentivement la progression d

opérationnel au sein des différentes entités.* Soutenir et piloter les initiatives financières et de contrôle de gestion visant à améliorer la gestion de la performance (concept et gestion des coûts facturation », à la gestion de projet et à la gestion des services.* Collaborer avec le service informatique pour améliorer les intégrations ERP et le reporting.* Préparer la migration des données en vue de la mise en oeuvre de SAP S/4HANA prévue pour .* Contribuer à l'amélioration de l'environnement informatique, en particulier au sein des organisations des ventes et des services, en automatisant les tâches afin d'améliorer la qualité, la satisfaction client et l'efficacité.**Management d'équipe :*** Diriger et développer l'équipe locale de contrôle de gestion.* Favoriser la collaboration au title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS-SBR)---Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================ Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.The Department of Process Engineering has a vacancy for aMaster thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in , which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design. **We are looking for** a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. **The preferred starting date is** September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\. **At Eawag**, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and . **Applications can be submitted until the position is filled** and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (max. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.For further information, please contact or . **We look forward to receiving your application.** Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.   Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology  ******jid92ba563jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

title: Manager - US Accounting and Reporting Group - USARG
description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100-100%
**Start Date:** 1. April 2027

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Lead and conduct PCAOB integrated audits of Swiss based multinational companies or Swiss subsidiaries of U.S. companies
* Audit spin-offs, disposals, opening balance sheets and acquired businesses in connection with various business combinations
* Lead and support other transaction-based projects that require IFRS / US GAAP / PCAOB / SEC reporting expertise (comfort letters, agreed-upon procedures and reviews of registration statements)
* Lead and deliver accounting advisory and SOX advisory services to non-audit clients
* Coach Swiss-based audit teams on technical US accounting, auditing and reporting inquiries
* Conduct internal and external PCAOB / US GAAS trainings



**This is what makes you successful**



* Strong knowledge of US GAAS/PCAOB and SEC requirements and US audit methodology. Knowledge of IFRS and International Standards on Auditing (ISA) is a plus
* Highly motivated, curious and proactive team player with a positive attitude, client service oriented and excellent oral and written communication skills
* 5-10 years of recent integrated (PCAOB and US GAAP or PCAOB and IFRS) audit experience with a Big 4 firm and proficiency in researching accounting and auditing issues.
* U.S. CPA license
* Technology skills including Alteryx, AI tools and data analytics
* Strong project management and team leadership skills
* Ability to deliver high-quality services under tight deadlines
* Proficient English skills. Other languages are a plus.



**Your benefits**

**Unlock Your Potential**

We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.
[Grow at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/grow-at-kpmg.html)



**Mentoring and Networking**

At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.
From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Health \& Wellbeing**

We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self-care webinars to leadership training. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.



**Pension Fund**

We offer above-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.



**Our Commitment**

Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. We are aware of the broader impact of our actions and provide trusted services with a consistent focus on ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance). In addition, we are actively committed to social responsibility by supporting volunteer work and promoting charitable projects through the KPMG Foundation.
[Commitment](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/commitment.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

title: Doctorant·e en science politique, avec spécialisation en politiques et administration publiques
employer: Faculté des sciences sociales et politiques, Université de Lausanne
description: Postulation via: https://career5.successfactors.eu/portalcareer?career%5fns=job%5flisting&company=universitdP&navBarLevel=JOB%5fSEARCH&rcm%5fsite%5flocale=en%5fUS&site=VjItQWt5MjVDbnNGNGlkV21MMFpPZDkrdz09&career_job_req_id=23032&selected_lang=fr_FR&jobAlertController_jobA(L'annonce complète se trouve sur unil.ch/travailler )Afin de compléter le laboratoire d’analyse de la gouvernance et de l’action publique en Europe (LAGAPE) de l’Institut d’études politiques (IEP), la Faculté des Sciences Sociales et Politiques est à la recherche d’une doctorante ou d'un doctorant en science politique, avec spécialisation en politiques publiques et/ou en administration publique.La personne engagée rejoindra l’équipe du projet de recherche international The Missing Link: How Public Administration Mediates the Impact of Citizen Participation and Integrated Policy Design on Trust in the Twin Transitions, financé par le Fonds national suisse (FNS) dans le cadre du programme Weave et mené en collaboration avec la Kozminski University (Varsovie) et l’Université d’Anvers (Belgique).Informations liées au posteEntrée en fonction : 01.03.2027 (ou à convenir)Durée du contrat : 1 an, renouvelable 3 x 1 an, maximum 4 ans selon financementTaux d'activité : 100 %Lieu de travail : Lausanne-Dorigny, UNIL-MoulineRémunération : Barème salarialVos activitésDans vos fonctions, vous serez notamment amené·e à :80 % du taux d’activité seront consacrés à la réalisation d’une thèse de doctorat sous la direction du Professeur Martino Maggetti, dans le cadre du projet « The Missing Link: How Public Administration Mediates the Impact of Citizen Participation and Integrated Policy Design on Trust in the Twin Transitions », ainsi qu’à des activités de recherche partagées au sein de l’équipe du projet (études de cas d’initiatives locales dans les domaines de la transition écologique et numérique, enquêtes auprès de responsables administratifs et de citoyen·ne·s, expériences par vignettes, publications communes).20 % du taux d’activité au maximum sera consacré au soutien à l’enseignement (animation et encadrement de séminaires, appui au cours, à la surveillance, aux examens oraux, et à la correction d’examens d’autres enseignements de la filière, etc.). D’autres tâches institutionnelles mineures pourront également être confiées.Description de poste : Cahier des chargesVotre profilNous souhaitons engager, afin de compléter notre équipe, une personne avec le profil suivant :     Maîtrise universitaire en science politique, administration publique, politiques publiques, ou titre jugé équivalent ;    Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais; la connaissance de l’allemand ou d’autres langues est un atout ;    Excellente maîtrise des méthodes et des processus de recherche en sciences sociales (qualitatives et/ou quantitatives) ; une expérience des études de cas, des enquêtes par questionnaire ou des méthodes expérimentales est un atout ;    Excellente connaissance du domaine de l’analyse des politiques publiques et/ou de l’administration publique ; un intérêt pour les questions de confiance, de participation citoyenne, d’intégration des politiques publiques ou de transition écologique et numérique est un atout ;    Forte motivation à accomplir une thèse de doctorat dans le domaine des politiques publiques et de l’administration publique ;    Aptitude à travailler de façon indépendante ainsi qu’en équipe, au sein d’un projet international, et à prendre en charge des activités de recherche en respectant les délais.    L'intérêt pour une carrière scientifique à long terme est un atout.Vos avantagesUn cadre de travail agréable dans un environnement académique multiculturel et diversifié.Des possibilités de formation continue, une multitude d'activités et d'autres avantages à découvrir.Davantage d'informations sur unil.ch/travaillerPour tout renseignement complémentaireProf. Martino Maggetti (martino.maggetti@unil.ch)Votre dossier de candidatureDélai de candidature : 18 décembre 2026Nous vous prions de bien vouloir nous transmettre votre dossier complet en format PDF. Ce dossier comprendra les éléments suivants :1) lettre de motivation ;2) CV détaillé avec liste de publications ;3) relevé de notes officiel et copie des diplômes universitaires ;4) un exemplaire du mémoire de master et/ou d’un travail de recherche (travail de séminaire, papier de colloque, ou autre publication scientifique) ;5) présentation succincte d’un projet de thèse (1 page) qui a un lien avec le projet décrit ci-dessous :The Missing Link: How Public Administration Mediates the Impact of Citizen Participation and Integrated Policy Design on Trust in the Twin TransitionsLa participation citoyenne et la conception intégrée des politiques publiques sont souvent présentées comme des moyens de renforcer la confiance dans les politiques de transition écologique et numérique (les transitions jumelles). En pratique, leurs effets sont incertains et parfois contre-productifs. Le projet explore le chaînon manquant de cette relation : ce qui se passe au sein de l’administration publique. Comment les responsables administratifs utilisent-ils les contributions des citoyen·ne·s ? Les unités administratives collaborent-elles ou se font-elles concurrence ? Comment la confiance et la méfiance façonnent-elles les relations entre les acteurs politico-administratifs, ainsi qu’avec les citoyen·ne·s ?Le projet étudie 24 initiatives locales dans les domaines de la transition écologique et numérique en Suisse, en Belgique et en Pologne, en combinant des études de cas, des enquêtes auprès de responsables administratifs et de citoyen·ne·s, et des expériences par vignettes. D’une durée de quatre ans, il est financé par le FNS, le NCN (Pologne) et le FWO (Flandre) dans le cadre du programme Weave, et dirigé par Martino Maggetti (Université de Lausanne), Dominika Latusek-Jurczak (Kozminski University) et Koen Verhoest (Université d’Anvers). La thèse portera sur le volet suisse du projet, dans une perspective comparative.Il ne sera pris en compte que les candidatures adressées par le biais de ce site. Nous vous remercions de votre compréhension.Les entretiens auront lieu courant janvier 2027.

title: Business Operations Manager, Commercial (100%)
description: Climeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions. Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment. By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society. Your mission: Build the commercial operating engine that enables Climeworks Solutions to scale and become the #1 portfolio manager in the carbon market.  You will turn complexity into simple, effective ways of working, connect processes, systems and data, and create the transparency teams need to make better decisions. By shaping scalable operations and digital customer solutions, you will enable Marketing, Sales and Customer Success to work seamlessly together, serve a growing customer base, and deliver greater value to our customers.  Your work will create the foundation for Climeworks Solutions to grow its customer base, become the most customer-centric CDR portfolio provider, and ultimately help build a mature global carbon removal market. Business analysis & solution design: You structure complex business problems, uncover root causes, and turn them into practical solutions. You align stakeholders, translate business needs into clear requirements, and prioritise improvements based on business impact and feasibility. Process & operational excellence: You continuously improve commercial processes, using AI, automation, and digital solutions to remove complexity and inefficiencies, and to scale how we work. You partner with commercial teams to ensure improvements are adopted and continuously refined. Analytics, reporting & data quality: You turn commercial data into actionable insights, developing reports and dashboards (in Salesforce, Power BI, or Microsoft tools) that help teams understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement. You conduct business analyses and drive data quality and reliability through effective controls and improvement measures. CRM & commercial tools: You drive improvements to Salesforce and our broader commercial toolset, working closely with our technical teams and external implementation partners to bring solutions to life. You remain close to the systems and users, ensuring that technology effectively supports our processes across marketing, sales, and customer success and evolves with the business needs. Project & change management: You lead operational improvement initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, and communicate outcomes through clear project updates and presentations. Knowledge management: You develop and maintain an internal knowledge base of processes, tools and enablement materials, making it easy for teams to access and apply best practices. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Floor Supervisor 100% (w/m/i)---Floor Supervisor 100% (w/m/i)=============================ab sofort oder nach VereinbarungFloor Supervisor 100% (w/m/i)=============================ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.     Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n:      Diese Aufgabe umfasst die Gewährleistung der Sauberkeit und Werterhaltung im ganzen , die Kontrolle der sowie der öffentlichen Räume und die Koordination aller anfallenden Arbeiten im Housekeeping. Sie sind zuständig für die Einweisung der Mitarbeitenden, Sie unterstützen durch laufende Schulungen und stellen somit die Gästezufriedenheit her.    Sie haben die Ausbildung zur Hotelfachfrau EFZ oder Fachfrau Hauswirtschaft erfolgreich abgeschlossen, sprechen Deutsch, sind dienstleistungsorientiert und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig und effizient. Sie zeigen hohes Bewusstsein für Sauberkeit und Ordnung, sind zuverlässig und arbeiten gerne im Team. Wenn Sie ausserdem noch den Berufsbildnerkurs besucht haben und Berufserfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position mitbringen, so ist dies von Vorteil. Wir erwarten ein gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten. Fremdsprachen sind ein zusätzliches Plus im Umgang mit unseren Mitarbeitenden und Gästen.    Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.    Auszeichnungen    Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»   Travel \+ Leisure«500 List 2021»   Handelszeitung«Bester Arbeitgeber  im Hospitality Sektor 2023»  Connoisseur Circle  «Best Gourmet Hotel»  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»       **BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG**  Alvarino  HR Business Partner  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon    ******jid5efa204jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.    Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n:    Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören* das Sicherstellen eines authentischen \& neuzeitlichen Speisenangebotes unter Berücksichtigung der Saisonprodukte des Originallandes sowie das Erstellen der ükarte in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Corporate Culinary Director* das Kreieren von neuen thailändischen Gerichten und Spezialitäten* die Zubereitung der thailändischen Gerichte sowie der einwandfreie Umgang mit Produkten, Produktion\- und Kochtechniken aus Thailand* die Verantwortung der Einhaltung der Hygienerichtlinien sowie der Arbeitssicherheit* das Kochen in der offenen Showküche vor demSie sind ein ausgebildeter Koch mit langjähriger Erfahrung sowie umfangreichem Fachwissen über die thailändische Spezialitätenküche sowie den fundierten thailändischen Kochtechniken. Sie haben Erfahrung in der internationalen gehobenen Gastronomie und Hotellerie. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschen Sie fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist von Vorteil. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind leidenschaftlich und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und gästeorientiert. Unternehmerisches Handeln und Denken zeichnet Sie aus.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.  Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.  Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.  Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.  Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.     Auszeichnungen:      *Swiss Location Awards **«Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»***   *World Spa Awards **«Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»***   *LHW Membership Awards **«Sustainability Leader»***   *Great Place To Work 2025*   *The New York Times'**«52 Places to Go in 2018»***   *Travel \+ Leisure**«500 List 2021»***   *Handelszeitung**«Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»***   *Connoisseur Circle **«Best Gourmet Hotel»***   *MICHELIN Wellness Award **«Best Wellness Hotel»***   *GALA Spa Awards **«Best Spa Concept»***   *MICHELIN Keys **«3/3 Keys»***    BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Lukretia  HR Manager  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen    ******jidcfa2c08jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

habitants.Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités ambulatoires, nous recherchons un ou une médecin généraliste souhaitant reprendre une activité médicale établie à Péry, à quelques minutes de Bienne.*Das **Réseau de l'Arc** ist fest in der Region verankert und zählt zu den bedeutenden Gesundheitsversorgern im Jurabogen.**Mit zwei Spitälern in Moutier und Saint\-Imier, neun Medicentres déjà établie ?Nous vous proposons une **opportunité de reprise d'un cabinet médical à Péry**, bénéficiant d'une patientèle existante et fidèle, d'un ancrage local solide et d'un important potentiel de Gesundheitsfachpersonen.** *Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Praxistätigkeit.*Qualifications--------------Nous recherchons une personnalité médicale engagée, souhaitant s'investir dans title: Chief Product Officer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Chief Product Officer--- Chief Product Officer=====================**Chief Product Officer (CPO)**-------------------------------**Company:** Coplanet AG**Location:** Tower, Gubelstrasse 24, 6300 Zug, Switzerland**Workload:** 100%**Start date:** As soon as possible or by agreement### **About Coplanet**Coplanet AG is an AI\-first agentic technology startup based in Zug, Switzerland. We have built an agentic AI app and are now taking it to market with business clients.### **The role**We are looking for an experienced Chief Product Officer to represent our product in the market. You will work hand in hand with the CCO as the business and technical partner during our go\-to\-market phase, bringing a strong knowledge of AI and of the technical side of the product into every commercial discussion. You will present the product in all client discussions, understand what clients need, answer their business and technical questions, and bring their feedback back to the product are a technical partner to the CTO/CAIO and contribute the client and market perspective that shapes product priorities. You will not be involved in the day\-to\-day building of the app.### **Key responsibilities**### **Client discussions and product presentation*** Represent and present the product in all client and prospect discussions, up to C\-level.* Lead product presentations and demonstrations, and explain what the product does, how it works and where it fits the client's business.* Answer clients' business and technical questions about the product with confidence, including questions on AI, security and data privacy.* Serve as the single point of contact for clients on product, scope and requirements.### **Business and technical partner to the CCO*** Work hand in hand with the CCO through the go\-to\-market phase: the CCO leads the commercial relationship, and the CPO leads the product narrative, solution design and fit, and covers the AI and technical side of the product.* Help shape deals and proposals so that they match what the product can deliver.* Ensure that commitments to clients match current capabilities and the agreed roadmap.### **Client requirements and feedback to the product team*** Understand complex client requirements, often involving several stakeholders, and translate them into clear, structured input for the product team.* Together with the CTO/CAIO, break complex product requirements down into technical epics and hand them over to the development team.* Bring client feedback, objections and unmet needs back to the product and engineering teams, and follow up on how they are addressed.* Give the CTO/CAIO a clear view of what clients need most, as input to product priorities.### **Product knowledge: security, privacy, governance and scalability*** Know the product in depth: how it works, how it is built and how it scales.* Understand client requirements on security, data privacy and governance, and make sure the product team addresses them.* Explain to clients how the product meets these requirements, and be clear about what it does not yet cover.### **Strategy and market insight*** Contribute to company and product strategy from both the business side and the technical side, together with the CTO/CAIO and the CCO.* Keep a current view of frontier agentic AI products and of how clients compare us with them.* Use this view to sharpen our positioning in client discussions and to inform product direction.### **Ownership and startup mindset*** Take ownership of your topics and see them through, without waiting to be asked.* Get involved proactively in topics beyond your core role, wherever the company needs you.* Bring a startup mindset: stay flexible as priorities and the role change.### **Your profile**### **Requirements*** **Excellent communication and presentation skills**, with the confidence to lead discussions with business and C\-level audiences.* **Confidence with AI products**: you can present them, explain them and answer questions about them credibly.* **A strong understanding of both the business side and the technical side of a product**, including security, data privacy, governance and scalability, so that you can handle most business and technical client questions independently.* **Experience working closely with commercial or sales leadership** on go\-to\-market.* **Extensive experience gathering complex client requirements** and turning them into product input.* **A technical background**, including hands\-on experience of having built software applications.* **At least 10 years of experience with software products**, including several years in a senior client\-facing product role such as Head of Product, VP Product, CPO or product\-focused solution lead.* **A well\-maintained network of decision\-makers in regulated industries**.* **Startup mindset and drive:** you want to build a strong agentic AI product that clients use in practice. You are hard\-working, flexible in your working hours and ready to go the extra mile. This is not a nine\-to\-five role.* **Languages:** fluent spoken Swiss , strong written and very good English are required.### **Nice to have*** A strong plus: hands\-on AI experience, including a real AI product you have built or brought to market.* Experience with governance, security and compliance topics, such as certifications, data privacy and data residency.* Experience in the same or a similar role at a startup.### **What we offer*** An AI\-first company where you work with cutting\-edge agentic technology every day.* A great deal of opportunity: an executive role in a small, growing company, where you shape your own role and grow with the company.* A strong technical team: a large, ambitious development team and an experienced leadership team behind the product.* An attractive workplace in the Tower in Zug, in a Swiss company built on Swiss standards of quality and reliability.* Flexible working. ![Coplanet AG]()* Coplanet AG  Gubelstrasse 24  6300 Zug*jid10b735djm jit1148jm jiy26jm

durant les premiers jours après une sortie d'hospitalisation  * Assurer les remplacements infirmiers et la couverture des horaires élargis au sein des CMS de l’Est vaudois.  * Assurer les soins infirmiers en **soirée et 2 week\-ends par mois** pour les CMS de l’Est vaudois.  * Coordonner les soins durant les week\-ends et jours fériés (Pour les personnes ayant les qualités nécessaires à dans la gestion des soins infirmiers.\- Accompagné\-e et entouré\-e d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire experte, vous effectuez les soins médico\-techniques et assurez le suivi de nos bénéficiaires.\- Vous élaborez avec le ou la bénéficiaire un projet de prise en charge en tenant compte de ses besoins prioritaires, de ses ressources, de celles de son entourage et de l’Équipe Mobile de Retour à Domicile.\- Vous mobilisez les ressources internes et externes, coordonnez la prise en charge et vous assurez du suivi de la situation, y compris par la mise à jour informatique des dossiers et votre title: Global Water Technologies Lead
description: The Nestlé Group is the world's largest food and beverage company with billion Swiss Francs in sales in 2019\. It is present in 187 countries around the world, has 403 factories and its 291'000 employees are committed to Nestlé's purpose of enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Nestlé offers a wide portfolio of products and services for people and their pets throughout their lives. Its more than 2000 brands range from global icons like Nescafé or Nespresso to local favourites. Company performance is driven by its Nutrition, Health and Wellness strategy. Nestlé is based in the Swiss town of Vevey where it was founded more than 150 years ago. Learn more about our Group and reasons to join us onGlobal Water Technologies Lead**Location:** Vevey, Switzerland  **Work model**: Hybrid / Full time  **Contract type / duration:** Permanent  **Target start date**: January 1, 2027  **Deadline for applications**: December 4, 2026**Be a force for good and inspire high\-performing Operations teams**As a **Global Water Technologies Lead at Global Operations**, your mission is to lead technical expertise in water and wastewater treatment and to guide a worldwide network of water experts, so our factories run safe, efficient and sustainable water systems. We are a global community of 150K\+ colleagues across the value chain \-Manufacturing \& Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Procurement and Agriculture\- driving focus, speed and meaningful impact for consumers. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with factory engineering teams, regional and market technical leaders, sustainability champions, procurement teams, suppliers, universities and research institutes. This is your opportunity to strengthen culture, competitiveness, and future\-ready capabilities as **\#OneOperations****How you'll make an impact as a Global Water Technologies Lead** * Leading technical expertise in water and wastewater treatment across Nestlé factories worldwide, setting the standard for safe, efficient and compliant systems.* Driving the water use reduction strategy by applying the Reduce, Reuse, Recycle model and introducing new technologies and digital solutions.* Building and guiding a global network of water experts who support wells, water treatment and effluent treatment operations and projects.* Delivering major investment projects, from new wells to water recycling systems, through standardised and future\-ready technologies.* Safeguarding food safety, quality and the environment by shaping standards for water as an ingredient, legionella prevention and effluent management.* Growing talent and partnerships by developing expert careers, global training programs and collaboration with universities, suppliers and knowledge partners.**What will make you successful** * Bringing recognized expertise in water treatment and effluent treatment, from system design to daily operations.* Leading and inspiring technical teams and expert networks through influence, coaching and collaboration.* Using a problem\-solving and continuous improvement mindset to manage risk, compliance, cost and performance.* Communicating fluently in English.* Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.**What to expect from our hiring process**We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.All internal candidates whose skills most closely align with the role's requirements will be considered. Please discuss your application with your HR Business Partner and line manager before applying.**Ready to Be a Force for Good?**Apply now and inspire high\-performing Operations teams.j4id10498021jm j4it1148jm j4iy26jm

title: Analyst
description: Millennium Management is a global hedge fund with more than 6,000 employees and offices in the United States, Europe and Asia.  We were founded in 1989, and we employ a global multi-strategy investment approach, opportunistically engaging in a broad array of trading and investing strategies. Millennium has differentiated itself from other investment management firms through our consistent ability over the last 35 years to generate returns that have not been correlated to the general market.The talent and dedication of our people are critical to our success. We offer an opportunity for developing one’s professional career while working with individuals trained in a variety of disciplines in a collegial and dynamic environment. We also offer a broad range of competitive benefits on a global basis. General Information- Hiring Department/Group:    Equities- Role:                                     Analyst- Office Location:                    Zug (CH)Job Function Summary:The successful candidate will support the Equities Volatility business through researching, developing, maintaining and monitoring option pricing and volatility models. They will partner closely with traders, quants, and technology teams to design the models used to price and risk-manage the book, deliver them into the team’s proprietary front-to-back trading platform, and keep them running during market hours, investigating and fixing issues in real time. The role requires strong analytical and modelling skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to move ideas from research to production in a fast-paced trading environment.Principal Responsibilities- Develop and maintain the team’s option pricing and volatility surface models. - Build analytics and front-end tools that support the traders’ decision-making.- Deliver risk, scenario and PnL explain views for the book, and support traders on day-to-day pricing and risk questions.- Contribute to the pricing and execution logic behind automated quoting and hedging.- Monitor pricing, risk and trading services during market hours, and debug and resolve production issues as they occur.- Take over a significant inherited codebase: understand it, keep it running in production, debug it and progressively improve it.- Own robust services and data pipelines, running in a real-time trading environment.Qualifications/Skills Required:- Master’s degree in applied mathematics (with specialism in probability and finance), physics or engineering from a university or equivalent institution.- Minimum of 2–4 years’ experience in an investment bank, including experience in derivatives, in a hybrid role covering quantitative research and quantitative development, to be able to demonstrate building trading models and shipping them as production code.- Strong understanding of derivatives pricing, stochastic calculus, numerical methods and volatility modelling.- Proficiency in Git and Linux required, and experience using Python C++. - Demonstrated experience of delivering production code used by traders and working in a large existing codebase.- Experience working in a fast-paced trading environment and demonstrated experience being able to prioritise under time pressure, take ownership and deliver robust solutions quickly.- Professional fluency in English required to be able to explain models clearly to traders and act on their feedback.

title: Advocacy officer – AMERICAS
description: Position summary : The Advocacy Officer (AO) supports and implements advocacy strategies related to the Americas region (50%) and provides general support to activities led by the International Advocacy Director (30%): Within the Americas program, the Advocacy Officer works with partner organizations and networks – particularly members of the Franciscan Family – at the country, regional, and international levels to coordinate and implement a regional advocacy strategy and related activities. The AO identifies key human rights issues within the region and opportunities to address these at the United Nations (UN). The AO also gathers and processes relevant information and facts related to the region.  The AO provides general support to the implementation of advocacy strategies and activities led by the International Advocacy Director.  The AO acts under the supervision of, and in cooperation with, the IAD and operates in compliance with FI’s vision and mission. About Franciscans International :Franciscans International is an international non-governmental organization, with general consultative status at the United Nations, working for the promotion and protection of human rights. Since its establishment in 1989, FI has used advocacy as a tool to address human rights abuses. From its offices in Geneva and New York, FI relies on the expertise and first-hand information of a large network of partners. We work together with and on behalf of Franciscan orders and congregations, as well as with grassroots movements and other civil society organizations to advocate for structural changes addressing the root causes of injustice.  MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES :Planning, management and monitoring results : Under the supervision of the IAD, implement FI’s advocacy strategy and related activities in the Americas region.  Coordination and networking : Coordinate with local partners on advocacy activities through facilitation of meetings, technical support, and mobilization. Participate in relevant regional meetings as needed. Ensure consultation of key constituencies to support FI’s work in specific countries and at the international level. Maintain and develop strategic contacts with Franciscans, non-governmental organizations (NGOs), UN agencies, diplomats, and other relevant partners. UN advocacy work : Address regional and/or country-specific concerns at UN level. Actively participate in relevant UN meetings and debates. Organize and coordinate advocacy work at the UN, including lobby meetings, awareness-raising events, and statements. Invite, organize, assist, and accompany local partners to take part in this work. Maintain and deepen networks and coalitions at international level for joint advocacy purposes.  UN reporting and research : Gather information through communication and coordination with partners. Draft and edit reports, briefings, and other advocacy and awareness-raising materials. Monitor and/or analyze developments concerning human rights issues relevant to FI’s advocacy strategy in the region. Translate information received from national partners into recommendations to UN human rights mechanisms. Capacity building : Implement capacity building activities and training programs for national partners on human rights advocacy. Coordinate and organize workshops and consultations with partners and other stakeholders in the region. Supervision : Assist in the supervision of consultants, provide oversight, and take responsibility for delegated assignments. Coordination with colleagues : Work with fundraising, project management, finance and communications team members. Perform all necessary administrative tasks.  Support to IAD : Assist with reporting on FI advocacy activities. Research and draft advocacy documents. Any other activities, including administrative tasks, required to assist the IAD in the implementation of FI’s overall advocacy strategy. CANDIDATE PROFILE Experience and qualifications :Advanced degree in law, international human rights law, international relations, development, or a related field. 1-3 years of relevant international human rights experience. Familiarity with UN human rights mechanisms, in particular the Human Rights Council and Treaty Bodies, is strongly desired. Experience working with NGOs is considered an asset.  Solid knowledge of the international human rights system, law, and policies. A sound understanding of the political context in which human rights advocacy processes take place.  Familiarity with human rights dynamics and trends in the Americas region, including related to human mobility.  Previous experience working with partners or organizations at the grassroots level is considered an asset. Skills and other requirements :Ability to effectively engage – including publicly – a wide range of audiences (diplomats, UN experts, affected communities, Franciscans, faith-leaders, and human rights defenders). Attention to detail and a strong commitment to achieving expected results. Ability to prioritize assignments and implement advocacy, fact-finding and capacity-building activities as well as monitor their impact. Strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills. The ability to work in a diverse team, support colleagues, and work with minimal supervision at times. Proficiency in oral and written English and Spanish is essential. Knowledge of other relevant regional languages, especially Portuguese, is considered as a strong asset. Availability to travel if needed, including to the Americas region.  Strong commitment to human rights, social issues, and environmental justice. FI OFFERS Experience in a professional human rights advocacy organization, with strong connections at the grassroots; and  The ability to grow and develop in a junior position; A weekly working time of 32 hours (80%), 20 days of annual leave, travel insurance, and a salary commensurate with experience.  Location :    Geneva, Switzerland  Reports to : International Advocacy Director (IAD) Contract : 80%, permanent position Start date : 1 February 2027, depending on availability   HOW TO APPLY Deadline for application: 25 December 2026 Applications should be sent in English by email to Mr. Budi Tjahjono at b.tjahjono@franciscansinternational.org specifying “Advocacy Officer” in the subject line.  Applications should include the following documents:  A Curriculum Vitae;  A 1-page letter of motivation;  2 references with contact details – email, phone number, and relation; and  Confirmation that you have a valid Swiss work permit or are eligible to obtain one. Please note that, due to the holiday period, shortlisted candidates will be contacted by 6 January 2027. First-round interviews will be conducted between 11 and 15 January 2027. The successful candidate should start on 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible, depending on availability.  Franciscans International is an equal opportunity employer. All interested candidates matching the requirements are welcome to apply whatever their origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, or belief. We thank all those who apply. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. We apologize that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
