title: Data Scientist 100%
description: The STRING database is a world-leading life science data resource in the field of protein networks, integrating known and predicted protein-protein links for a quickly growing user community. STRING is being developed by an international team at the following three locations: EMBL (Heidelberg), University of Zurich, and University of Turku. The Zurich team (headed by Prof. Christian von Mering) is looking for a skilled and motivated individual to help grow STRING and its associated data resources with new algorithms and analysis tools. The person will help develop these ideas and design the data flow and analysis toolsets. We are looking for a scientific developer with a good understanding of data, able to contribute to all steps from the primary data, through machine learning and statistical scoring, to the end user. Applicants should be able to build pipelines and critically review code, and can choose their own preferred languages and tools, as long as their approach is compatible with a strong focus on scientific accuracy and user experience.Profile requirements:A solid background in either the Life Sciences or Statistics is essential; experience in machine learning is a strong plus.The position will be available as of February 1st, 2027. It is offered for a period of two years initially, with the possibility of extensions towards an open-ended contract. For any further information, please contact the group directly, at damian.szklarzcyk@uzh.ch or mering@mls.uzh.chFor more information about the database and the team, click on the following links:STRING database: https://string-db.org/The Zurich Team: https://www.mls.uzh.ch/en/research/von-mering

title: Manager - US Accounting and Reporting Group - USARG
description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100-100%
**Start Date:** 1. April 2027

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Lead and conduct PCAOB integrated audits of Swiss based multinational companies or Swiss subsidiaries of U.S. companies
* Audit spin-offs, disposals, opening balance sheets and acquired businesses in connection with various business combinations
* Lead and support other transaction-based projects that require IFRS / US GAAP / PCAOB / SEC reporting expertise (comfort letters, agreed-upon procedures and reviews of registration statements)
* Lead and deliver accounting advisory and SOX advisory services to non-audit clients
* Coach Swiss-based audit teams on technical US accounting, auditing and reporting inquiries
* Conduct internal and external PCAOB / US GAAS trainings



**This is what makes you successful**



* Strong knowledge of US GAAS/PCAOB and SEC requirements and US audit methodology. Knowledge of IFRS and International Standards on Auditing (ISA) is a plus
* Highly motivated, curious and proactive team player with a positive attitude, client service oriented and excellent oral and written communication skills
* 5-10 years of recent integrated (PCAOB and US GAAP or PCAOB and IFRS) audit experience with a Big 4 firm and proficiency in researching accounting and auditing issues.
* U.S. CPA license
* Technology skills including Alteryx, AI tools and data analytics
* Strong project management and team leadership skills
* Ability to deliver high-quality services under tight deadlines
* Proficient English skills. Other languages are a plus.



**Your benefits**

Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Health \& Wellbeing**

We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self-care webinars to leadership training. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.



**Pension Fund**

We offer above-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.



**Our Commitment**

Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. We are aware of the broader impact of our actions and provide trusted services with a consistent focus on ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance). In addition, we are actively committed to social responsibility by supporting volunteer work and promoting charitable projects through the KPMG Foundation.
[Commitment](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/commitment.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. title: Business Operations Manager, Commercial (100%)
description: Climeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions. Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment. By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society. Your mission: Build the commercial operating engine that enables Climeworks Solutions to scale and become the #1 portfolio manager in the carbon market.  You will turn complexity into simple, effective ways of working, connect processes, systems and data, and create the transparency teams need to make better decisions. By shaping scalable operations and digital customer solutions, you will enable Marketing, Sales and Customer Success to work seamlessly together, serve a growing customer base, and deliver greater value to our customers.  Your work will create the foundation for Climeworks Solutions to grow its customer base, become the most customer-centric CDR portfolio provider, and ultimately help build a mature global carbon removal market. Business analysis & solution design: You structure complex business problems, uncover root causes, and turn them into practical solutions. You align stakeholders, translate business needs into clear requirements, and prioritise improvements based on business impact and feasibility. Process & operational excellence: You continuously improve commercial processes, using AI, automation, and digital solutions to remove complexity and inefficiencies, and to scale how we work. You partner with commercial teams to ensure improvements are adopted and continuously refined. Analytics, reporting & data quality: You turn commercial data into actionable insights, developing reports and dashboards (in Salesforce, Power BI, or Microsoft tools) that help teams understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement. You conduct business analyses and drive data quality and reliability through effective controls and improvement measures. CRM & commercial tools: You drive improvements to Salesforce and our broader commercial toolset, working closely with our technical teams and external implementation partners to bring solutions to life. You remain close to the systems and users, ensuring that technology effectively supports our processes across marketing, sales, and customer success and evolves with the business needs. Project & change management: You lead operational improvement initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, and communicate outcomes through clear project updates and presentations. Knowledge management: You develop and maintain an internal knowledge base of processes, tools and enablement materials, making it easy for teams to access and apply best practices. Your story: Education & experience: You hold a university degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Sustainability, or a related field and bring 4-10 years of experience in commercial operations or business transformation, ideally across both consulting and in-house environments. Commercial operations & business analysis: You bring strong experience in business analysis, revenue operations, commercial excellence, or business transformation, ideally across marketing, sales, and customer success. You are skilled at unpacking ambiguous business problems, identifying root causes, mapping processes, and translating business needs into clear requirements and practical solutions. CRM & business systems: You have experience enhancing Salesforce or another CRM, bridging between business and technical teams. You understand how commercial systems, data, and processes fit together, and are comfortable shaping solution designs and steering technical partners through implementation, testing, and roll-out. Experience with Salesforce administration is a plus, as is exposure to marketing automation tools and ERPs such as SAP. Analytics: You are comfortable working with imperfect data, structuring analyses, creating reports and dashboards in Salesforce, and extracting business insights. Experience with Power BI, or comparable analytics tools is a plus. Stakeholder management: You build credibility with stakeholders across functions and seniority levels and enjoy partnering with others to solve business problems. Organisation & execution: You turn ambiguous challenges into actionable work packages, prioritise effectively, and drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption. Mindset & ownership: You bring strong business judgement and a high degree of ownership. You do what it takes to move things forward, whether that means shaping the bigger picture or getting into the details and tackling the work yourself. You are pragmatic, with a bias for action and continuous improvement. You know how to balance scalability and speed in a fast-changing environment. Language: You have excellent written and spoken English skills. Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together. What we offer: Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays. Location: This position is based in Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week. We offer up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country. Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter. Family Support: Inclusive parental leave. Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth. Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals. Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. description: Position summary : The Advocacy Officer (AO) supports and implements advocacy strategies related to the Americas region (50%) and provides general support to activities led by the International Advocacy Director (30%): Within the Americas program, the Advocacy Officer works with partner organizations and networks – particularly members of the Franciscan Family – at the country, regional, and international levels to coordinate and implement a regional advocacy strategy and related activities. About Franciscans International :Franciscans International is an international non-governmental organization, with general consultative status at the United Nations, working for the promotion and protection of human rights. Since its establishment in 1989, FI has used advocacy as a tool to address human rights abuses. From its offices in Geneva and New York, FI relies on the expertise and first-hand information of a large network of partners. We work together with and on behalf of Franciscan orders and congregations, as well as with grassroots movements and other civil society organizations to advocate for structural changes addressing the root causes of injustice.  MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES :Planning, management and monitoring results : Under the supervision of the IAD, implement FI’s advocacy strategy and related activities in the Americas region.  Coordination and networking : Coordinate with local partners on advocacy activities through facilitation of meetings, technical support, and mobilization. UN advocacy work : Address regional and/or country-specific concerns at UN level. Actively participate in relevant UN meetings and debates. Organize and coordinate advocacy work at the UN, including lobby meetings, awareness-raising events, and statements. Invite, organize, assist, and accompany local partners to take part in this work. Maintain and deepen networks and coalitions at international level for joint advocacy purposes.  UN reporting and research : Gather information through communication and coordination with partners. Draft and edit reports, briefings, and other advocacy and awareness-raising materials. Monitor and/or analyze developments concerning human rights issues relevant to FI’s advocacy strategy in the region. Translate information received from national partners into recommendations to UN human rights mechanisms. Capacity building : Implement capacity building activities and training programs for national partners on human rights advocacy. Coordinate and organize workshops and consultations with partners and other stakeholders in the region. Supervision : Assist in the supervision of consultants, provide oversight, and take responsibility for delegated assignments. Coordination with colleagues : Work with fundraising, project management, finance and communications team members. Perform all necessary administrative tasks.  Support to IAD : Assist with reporting on FI advocacy activities. Research and draft advocacy documents. Any other activities, including administrative tasks, required to assist the IAD in the implementation of FI’s overall advocacy strategy. CANDIDATE PROFILE Experience and qualifications :Advanced degree in law, international human rights law, international relations, development, or a related field. 1-3 years of relevant international human rights experience. Familiarity with UN human rights mechanisms, in particular the Human Rights Council and Treaty Bodies, is strongly desired. Experience working with NGOs is considered an asset.  Solid knowledge of the international human rights system, law, and policies. A sound understanding of the political context in which human rights advocacy processes take place.  Familiarity with human rights dynamics and trends in the Americas region, including related to human mobility.  Previous experience working with partners or organizations at the grassroots level is considered an asset. Skills and other requirements :Ability to effectively engage – including publicly – a wide range of audiences (diplomats, UN experts, affected communities, Franciscans, faith-leaders, and human rights defenders). Attention to detail and a strong commitment to achieving expected results. Ability to prioritize assignments and implement advocacy, fact-finding and capacity-building activities as well as monitor their impact. Strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills. The ability to work in a diverse team, support colleagues, and work with minimal supervision at times. Proficiency in oral and written English and Spanish is essential. Knowledge of other relevant regional languages, especially Portuguese, is considered as a strong asset. Availability to travel if needed, including to the Americas region.  Strong commitment to human rights, social issues, and environmental justice. FI OFFERS Experience in a professional human rights advocacy organization, with strong connections at the grassroots; and  The ability to grow and develop in a junior position; A weekly working time of 32 hours (80%), 20 days of annual leave, travel insurance, and a salary commensurate with experience.  Location :    Geneva, Switzerland  Reports to : International Advocacy Director (IAD) Contract : 80%, permanent position Start date : 1 February 2027, depending on availability   HOW TO APPLY Deadline for application: 25 December 2026 Applications should be sent in English by email to Mr. Budi Tjahjono at b.tjahjono@franciscansinternational.org specifying “Advocacy Officer” in the subject line.  Applications should include the following documents:  A Curriculum Vitae;  A 1-page letter of motivation;  2 references with contact details – email, phone number, and relation; and  Confirmation that you have a valid Swiss work permit or are eligible to obtain one. The successful candidate should start on 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible, depending on availability.  Franciscans International is an equal opportunity employer. title: Observatory Systems Engineer for LIFE Space Mission

Our mission is to position ETH Zurich as Europe's leading institution in space research and education, while also being recognized as a premier partner for space-related projects within Switzerland and globally. As part of the ETH Zurich | Space engineering team, you will take a leading technical role in the development of LIFE, working closely with the mission's scientific and engineering teams, international partners, and industrial suppliers. This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungYou will take senior technical responsibility for systems engineering of the LIFE observatory and its prototype and precursor developments,  payload and spacecraft systems engineering, integration and test, and technical coordination. their development and implementation across the participating organizations.As part of your role, you will:Lead and coordinate the technical development of assigned LIFE mission, observatory, and payload elements across the mission consortium and industrial partners, ensuring alignment on requirements, interfaces, schedules, and technical decisions in close collaboration with LIFE project institutions and suppliers, defining and controlling interfaces between instruments, optical assemblies, structures, spacecraft platforms, and other subsystems.Manage technical budgets for mass, power, thermal, data, pointing, and limited-life resources.Develop mission architectures covering launch and orbit selection, platform and payload architecture, ground segment, operations planning, launch campaign preparation, and in-orbit commissioning.Lead cross-discipline trade studies balancing scientific return, technology readiness, mission feasibility, schedule, and cost, particularly in engineering and test teams across participating institutions and suppliers.Develop and execute test plans and procedures from component to observatory level, including acceptance and post-delivery testing of externally supplied hardware and environmental testing (thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, EMI/EMC).Manage nonconformances; support or coordinate failure and anomaly review boards, objectives.Lead technical risk identification, analysis, and mitigation using methods such as FMECA and fault tree analysis.Lead the technical preparation and coordination of mission and payload lifecycle reviews, including defining review objectives, technical content, and required documentation, and presenting engineering results and recommendations at MDR, PRR, SRR, PDR, CDR, QR, AR, and test readiness reviews.Provide technical oversight of suppliers developing flight and test hardware for LIFE, from specification through acceptance and delivery, and contribute to the integration and test infrastructure required for LIFE prototype, instrument, and observatory development.Coordinate additional technical resources from students and external partners with the project leadership team, mentor junior engineers and students, and contribute to teaching in the Space Systems program where appropriate.Contribute technical content to mission proposals and funding applications, including ESA, SSO, SNSF, and Innosuisse proposals.Ihr ProfilYou have extensive experience in space systems engineering and enjoy taking technical responsibility across disciplines and organizations. You combine sound engineering judgment with a practical approach to solving complex technical problems and coordinating multidisciplinary teams.We are looking for someone with:A degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, systems engineering, physics, or a related field, combined with substantial relevant professional experience. An advanced degree is an advantage.10+ years of relevant practical experience in space systems engineering, mission architecture, payload/instrument engineering, or spacecraft engineering.Systems engineering experience at the integrated payload or observatory level on the James Webb Space Telescope, Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, or a comparable large space astrophysics mission, ideally spanning element delivery through integration, test, launch and commissioning.Experience serving as technical authority or interface lead for an integrated payload or observatory composed of elements from different institutions and suppliers (e.g., telescope assembly, science instruments, and supporting structure).Demonstrated senior technical responsibility across the design, development, manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test lifecycle of space-flight missions, payloads, or instruments.Hands-on experience leading verification and validation across multiple requirement levels (e.g., mission, payload, and element), and leading environmental test campaigns at payload or observatory level, including thermal vacuum, dynamics, and EMI/EMC.Strong system-level analysis and trade-study skills, with an in-depth understanding of mission requirements, systems engineering principles, and lifecycle processes.Experience managing technical requirements, interfaces, and supplier deliverables across multiple institutions and industrial partners, including technical oversight of flight-hardware subcontracts.Experience with optical, infrared, or cryogenic science instruments, including root-cause analysis, fault tree analysis, and corrective action.Demonstrated technical leadership and sound engineering judgment, with the ability to establish priorities, resolve complex technical issues, and drive multidisciplinary engineering activities toward project milestones.Proven ability to lead and coordinate distributed, multi-institution teams without direct line authority, title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS-SBR)---Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================ Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.The Department of Process Engineering has a vacancy for aMaster thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in , which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design. **We are looking for** a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. **The preferred starting date is** September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\. **At Eawag**, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions.
